English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗?

English: Okay, I think I get it.
Chinese: 好,我明白了。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Actually, I had other questions.
Chinese: 其实,我还有别的问题。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就这些。

English: <<The youth looks at you with caution; wide eyes lodged in a gaunt face.>> Oh, a newcomer! Uh, w-w-welcome to [[Pwyll Village]]. My name's Lludd. Were you... um... involved in all that ((commotion)) over at the old fort?
Chinese: <<青年警惕地望着你;瘦削的脸上嵌着一双大眼睛。>>哦,新来的!呃,欢——欢迎来到[[普威尔村]]。我叫卢德。旧堡垒那边那场((骚动)),你……呃……有份参与吗?

English: Sure. I've just killed more folk than you could count.
Chinese: 是啊。我刚杀了的人多到你数不过来。

English: <<The young man's jaw hangs agape as he searches for words.>> ##Oh my. Oh wow. I suppose there would have been... um... <<He swallows.>> ...A lot of blood, and such?
Chinese: <<年轻人目瞪口呆,不知说什么好。>> ##天哪。哇哦。那应该会有……呃……<<他咽了口唾沫。>>……很多血之类的?

English: Yes, of course there was fucking ((blood)).
Chinese: 对,当然他妈的有((血))。

English: <<He visibly flinches.>> Ah. Yes. Of course. I thought so. ##<<He looks around, as if for something to say.>> Did I mention... that our town is called [[Pwyll]]?
Chinese: <<他明显地瑟缩了一下。>>啊。对。当然。我就知道。 ##<<他四下张望,似乎在找话说。>>我提过……我们镇子叫[[普威尔]]吗?

English: No, I killed them with harsh words.
Chinese: 不,我是用恶毒的话杀的。

English: <<He nods quickly, as if this is a perfectly reasonable statement.>> Ah. Yes. Of course. ##<<He looks around, as if for something to say.>> Did I mention... that our town is called [[Pwyll]]?
Chinese: <<他飞快点着头,仿佛这话再合理不过。>>啊。对。当然。 ##<<他四下张望,似乎在找话说。>>我提过……我们镇子叫[[普威尔]]吗?

English: Are you okay? You seem awfully faint.
Chinese: 你还好吗?你脸色看着很差。

English: <<He nods quickly, but he seems to have grown paler since you started talking.>> Um, I'm fine, thank you. Did you... want to know about [[Pwyll]]?
Chinese: <<他飞快点着头,但自你开口以来他似乎更苍白了。>>呃,我没事,谢谢。你想……了解[[普威尔]]吗?

English: I'm an Inquisition agent - hunting criminals of the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 我是宗教裁判所探员——正在追捕叛教联盟的罪犯。

English: <<He shivers and looks you up and down.>> Oh! I'm sorry, I didn't realise. You don't much ((look)) like one of those agents - you must be... ((undercover)), right? <<he whispers,>>  ##Well, if it would help... I could tell you about our t-t-town?
Chinese: <<他打了个哆嗦,上下打量你。>>哦!抱歉,我没看出来。你看上去不太((像))那种探员——你一定是……((卧底)),对吧?<<他低声道,>> ##呃,如果用得上的话……我可以给你讲讲我们小——小镇?

English: I'm just passing through; I won't cause you any trouble.
Chinese: 我只是路过,不会给你添麻烦。

English: <<The boy's shoulders slacken and he looks genuinely relieved.>> Oh, okay. I can tell you a little about our town, if you like?
Chinese: <<男孩肩膀松了下来,看上去真心松了口气。>>哦,好。如果你愿意,我可以给你讲讲我们镇子?

English: We're just a humble village. <<He swallows.>> Have you heard of [[scryshroom?]] It's a mushroom that shows you the f-f-future. We grow it and sell it. Only... um... things aren't going so well, lately. People are worried.
Chinese: 我们只是个不起眼的小村。<<他咽了口唾沫。>>你听说过[[窥菇]]吗?是一种能让你看见未——未来的蘑菇。我们种它、卖它。只是……呃……近来情况不太妙。大家都很担心。

English: What's going wrong, exactly?
Chinese: 究竟出了什么问题?

English: Well, the crop yield is... bad. Each year we've been growing less scryshroom. ##<<He scratches his head.>> Some people are getting worried...
Chinese: 呃,收成很……糟。每年我们的窥菇都种得更少。 ##<<他挠挠头。>>有些人开始担心了……

English: <<He looks around, then leans in closer.>> I've heard some people are considering the ((old ways)). ##<<His eyes are practically bulging.>> You know, consorting with ((Wikkans)) and ((gods))?
Chinese: <<他四下看看,然后凑近。>>我听说有些人在考虑((老法子))。 ##<<他的眼睛几乎要瞪出来了。>>就是跟((维坎教徒))和((神明))勾勾搭搭那种?

English: That's very stupid of them.
Chinese: 他们可真蠢。

English: <<The boy nods furiously.>> Of ((course)). Very illegal! But also kind of ((exciting)), wouldn't you say? ##<<He seems to regret his choice of words.>> Oh, um, I just mean - it's very ((boring)) here sometimes...
Chinese: <<男孩拼命点头。>>((那当然))。非常违法!不过也有点((刺激)),你不觉得吗? ##<<他似乎后悔自己用词了。>>哦,呃,我只是说——这儿有时候很((无聊))……

English: So what?
Chinese: 那又怎样?

English: Well, we're part of the Apostatic Union, see? So god-worship is very... ((illegal)). <<He gulps.>>
Chinese: 嗯,我们是叛教联盟的一员,懂吧?所以拜神是非常……((违法))的。<<他倒吸一口气。>>

English: Actually, forget it.
Chinese: 其实,算了吧。

English: <<He looks nervous.>> Oh, I've been waffling again, haven't I? Did you want to know anything else?
Chinese: <<他显得紧张。>>哦,我又絮叨个没完,是吧?你还想知道别的吗?

English: Anyway, the [[local weighmaster Culwych]] has gotten pretty spooked by it all. He's weighing everyone who comes by, just to make sure they're not a Wikkan.
Chinese: 总之,[[本地秤量官卡尔威奇]]被这些事吓得够呛。每个路过的人他都要过秤,就为确保对方不是维坎教徒。

English: But my mother [[Olwen]] - oh, um, she's the mayor, by the way - doesn't seem too bothered by it all. She's much too worried about something else. I heard her mumbling about [[some sort of monster]] lately...
Chinese: 但我母亲[[奥尔温]]——哦,呃,顺便说一句,她是镇长——对这一切倒不怎么在意。她有更要紧的事担心。我最近听见她喃喃念叨着[[什么怪物]]……

English: <<He blinks.>> Oh, I'm sorry, I do tend to waffle, don't I? Is there... anything you'd like to know?
Chinese: <<他眨眨眼。>>哦,抱歉,我确实容易絮叨,是吧?你还有……什么想了解的吗?

English: Can you point me around town?
Chinese: 能带我认认镇上的路吗?

English: Oh, um, I suppose so. <<He gestures behind him.>> Just in town you'll find the [[weigh house]]. The weighmaster C-C-Culwych, he's pretty respected around here. Nearby is the [[Scryshroom Company]], which sells scyrshooms of course. And, uh, other things.
Chinese: 哦,呃,应该可以。<<他指指身后。>>镇上就有[[称量所]]。秤——秤量官卡尔威奇,他在这一带很受尊敬。旁边是[[窥菇公司]],当然卖窥菇。还有,呃,别的东西。

English: Further up the hill is the [[mayor's house]]. That's where my mother - uh, I mean the ((mayor)) lives. She sometimes has work going. ##And further up is the old [[sacred shroom]]. Only, uh, it's dead.
Chinese: 再往山上走是[[镇长宅邸]]。我母亲——呃,我是说((镇长))——就住在那儿。她有时有活儿找人做。 ##再往上就是古老的[[神圣蘑菇]]。只是,呃,它已经死了。

English: What does the weighmaster do?
Chinese: 秤量官是做什么的?

English: Oh, Culwych? He's pretty important. He went to Riova - the capital city of the Apostatic Union, that's ((really)) far away - to get certified as a weighmaster.
Chinese: 哦,卡尔威奇?他相当重要。他去过里奥瓦——叛教联盟的国都,那可((非常))遥远——去考取秤量官的认证。

English: He weighs things for merchants and buyers to make sure the price is fair. Might not seem like much, but for a small town like us, it means we can trade with realms like Vena, Byonne and L-L-Lundel.
Chinese: 他为商人和买家称重,确保价格公道。听起来不起眼,但对我们这样的小镇来说,这意味着能跟维纳、拜昂和伦——伦德尔那些地方做生意。

English: <<He leans closer, eyes wide.>> But he also weighs ((people)). Lately he's been real worried about [[Wikkan sympathisers]], and he has magic cipher scales that can ((tell)) if you're ((evil)).
Chinese: <<他凑近,眼睛瞪得老大。>>但他也给((人))过秤。最近他为[[维坎同情者]]的事忧心忡忡,他有魔法密文天平,能((测出))你是不是((坏人))。

English: <<He looks sheepish.>> He's not weighed me though. I guess he doesn't think I'm t-t-tough enough to be a criminal.
Chinese: <<他一脸窘迫。>>不过他还没给我称过。我想他觉得我不够强——强壮,当不了罪犯。

English: Tell me about the Scryshroom Company.
Chinese: 跟我说说窥菇公司。

English: Well, it's run by Dwynn, whose family's been growing scryshroom for generations. Without his company the town wouldn't really exist, mushrooms are kinda all there is around here.
Chinese: 呃,公司是德温开的,他家世代种窥菇。没有他的公司,这镇子根本不会存在,这一带除了蘑菇几乎啥都没有。

English: Mother won't let me drink the scyrshroom tea, even though ((she)) does all the time. She s-s-says it's too intense. That you have to be a responsible adult to see the future.
Chinese: 母亲不让我喝窥菇茶,尽管((她自己))天天喝。她——她说那玩意太猛。说必须有责任心的成年人才能看未来。

English: I don't see the big deal, though. She mostly just hallucinates about having a bigger garden.
Chinese: 可我不觉得有什么大不了。她多半只是幻想自己有个更大的花园。

English: So your mother is the mayor?
Chinese: 所以你母亲是镇长?

English: <<He nods.>> Not everyone likes her, because she comes from all the way over in Lundel. That's a faraway place with castles and windswept moors, in Union heartland.
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>不是人人都喜欢她,因为她来自远方的伦德尔。那是联盟腹地一个遥远的地方,有城堡和朔风猎猎的旷野。

English: I was born here, so I've never been. <<He sniffs.>>
Chinese: 我出生在这儿,所以从没去过。<<他吸了吸鼻子。>>

English: Why is the Sacred Shroom dead?
Chinese: 神圣蘑菇为什么死了?

English: Oh! Well that's because Culwych killed our god, of course.
Chinese: 哦!那当然是因为卡尔威奇杀了我们的神。

English: Of course.
Chinese: 这还用说。

English: <<He nods.>>
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>

English: Uh, would you care to elaborate?
Chinese: 呃,能详细说说吗?

English: Oh, um, I'm sorry, I forget not everyone knows about it! <<He chuckles meekly.>> ##Our old god was Aenguin and he was really mean. Like he wanted people to sacrifice themselves at the Sacred Shrooms to make the scryshrooms grow good.
Chinese: 哦,呃,抱歉,我忘了不是人人都知道这事!<<他怯怯地笑了笑。>> ##我们的旧神是安圭因,他特别刻薄。他要求人们在神圣蘑菇那儿献祭自己,好让窥菇长得好。

English: So in the God War, Culwych and a few others sailed a huge Kardovan skyship and speared Aenguin in the eye. Because he was part of the Sacred Shroom on the hill, the mushroom died along with him.
Chinese: 于是在神之战中,卡尔威奇和几个伙伴驾着一艘巨大的卡尔多瓦天船,一矛刺穿了安圭因的眼睛。因为他是山上那株神圣蘑菇的一部分,蘑菇也就随他一起死了。

English: <<He sniffs.>>But, that's also why the harvests are bad. Really, the only reason we had scryshrooms in the first place is because of our god. There's only one Sacred Shroom left, and if that goes we're... well... ((I'm not allowed to use that word.))
Chinese: <<他吸了吸鼻子。>>不过,这也是收成差的原因。说真的,我们当初会有窥菇,全是因为我们的神。如今只剩一株神圣蘑菇,要是它也没了,我们就……那个……((那个词妈妈不让我说。))

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就这些。

English: <<He nods.>> I hope I didn't w-w-waffle too much.
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>希望我没有太絮——絮叨。

English: I've gotta get going, kid.
Chinese: 我得走了,小子。

English: Oh, um, of course. B-b-bye.
Chinese: 哦,呃,当然。再——再见。

English: Oh, hello again. Did you want me to p-p-point you around Pwyll? Or... I don't suppose... you're here to help with our problems?
Chinese: 哦,又见面了。你想让我带你认——认认普威尔的路?还是……你不会是……来帮我们解决问题的吧?

English: Oh, hello again. Was there s-s-something you wanted to ask?
Chinese: 哦,又见面了。你有什——什么想问的吗?

English: Do you know anything about these Wikkan sympathisers?
Chinese: 关于这些维坎同情者,你知道点什么吗?

English: <<Lludd suddenly looks very pale.>> Oh, you mean people who are ((cavorting)) with ((god-worship))? ##<<A bead of sweat rolls down his face.>> T-t-they say it's a ((criminal act)), right? That you could be locked up forever?
Chinese: <<卢德突然脸色煞白。>>哦,你是说那些((沉溺))于((拜神))的人? ##<<一滴冷汗从他脸上滚下。>>他——他们说那是((犯罪行为)),对吧?会被永远关起来的那种?

English: <<He shakes his head.>> I'm sorry, but I don't know anything about it. You could try [[Nudd]], who's usually in the [[Scryshroom Company House]]. He used to be a mercenary and stuff. I'm sure he knows about such things.
Chinese: <<他摇摇头。>>抱歉,这我什么都不知道。你可以去试试[[纳德]],他通常在[[窥菇公司]]里。他从前当过佣兵什么的。这种事他肯定懂。

English: <<The nauseating stench of bile engulfs the flesh-chamber. Before you, a huge digestional tract pulsates and throbs with corrosive acid. ##It would seem as though this mushroom has ((organs.))>>
Chinese: <<令人作呕的胆汁恶臭充斥着血肉之腔。你面前,一条巨大的消化道随着腐蚀性的酸液搏动、抽搐。 ##看来这株蘑菇是有((器官。))>>

English: <<Lludd writhes behind the digestive membrane, clearly in agony. When he sees you, he looks shocked.>> ##Y-y-you!
Chinese: <<卢德在消化膜后翻腾,显然痛苦不堪。见到你时,他一脸震惊。>> ##是——是你!

English: We need to get you out of there.
Chinese: 我们得把你弄出来。

English: ((No))! <<A look of determination seizes Lludd.>> If I don't ((do)) this, the village w-w-will ((perish))!
Chinese: ((不))!<<卢德脸上涌起一股决然。>>我要是不((做))这件事,村子就——就会((完蛋))!

English: And if you cut me free, you'll be slicing into the mushroom's organs. You could [[kill it]]!
Chinese: 而且你要是割开救我,就会切到蘑菇的器官。你可能会[[杀死它]]!

English: But you'll ((die)).
Chinese: 可你会((死))。

English: D-d-don't you think I ((know)) that?
Chinese: 你——你以为我((不知道))吗?

English: Suit yourself.
Chinese: 随你便。

English: Even ((y-y-you)) don't take me seriously!
Chinese: 连((你——你))都不把我当回事!

English: Who did this to you?
Chinese: 这是谁对你做的?

English: ((Nobody))! <<A look of determination seizes Lludd.>>
Chinese: ((没人))!<<卢德脸上涌起一股决然。>>

English: Everyone assumes I'm just some stupid k-k-kid. Just the mayor's idiot son. They don't take me ((seriously))! ##But now I can show I'm w-w-worth something. I can ((save)) the village, all by myself.
Chinese: 人人都当我是某个笨小——小孩。就是镇长的傻儿子。没人把我((当回事))! ##但现在我能证明自己有——有价值。我能((拯救))村子,全靠我自己。

English: I found the old Wikkan contract-rites, stashed in my mother's basement. I convinced Emyr to help me set it up, but it was ((me)) who whispered to Aenguin and felt his reply echo through my b-b-bones.
Chinese: 我找到了古老的维坎契约仪轨,藏在我母亲的地下室里。我说服埃米尔帮我布设,但向安圭因低语、感到他的回应在我骨——骨子里回荡的,是((我))。

English: The village isn't worth ((dying)) for, kid.
Chinese: 村子不值得你((死)),小子。

English: S-s-says ((who))? Culwych is always talking of his war buddies, who died to liberate Pwyll. But w-w-why's that any different from this? Just because we're not at ((war))?
Chinese: 谁——谁((说的))?卡尔威奇总念叨他的战友,那些为解放普威尔而死的人。可那跟这有什——什么两样?就因为现在不在((打仗))?

English: I'm getting you out of there, whether you like it or not.
Chinese: 不管你愿不愿意,我都要把你弄出来。

English: N-n-nobody lets me make my own ((decisions)). I've been planning this for m-m-months! It's my choice!
Chinese: 没——没人让我自己做((决定))。这计划我筹划了好几——几个月!这是我的选择!

English: I admire your guts, at least.
Chinese: 至少我佩服你的胆量。

English: Pwyll is ((dying)). Everyone says so. Since Aenguin was killed, the soil's d-d-drying up. In another generation there'll be nothing ((left)). This is the ((only)) way to save the village.
Chinese: 普威尔正在((死去))。人人都这么说。安圭因被杀之后,土壤正在干——干涸。再过一代人,就什么都不((剩))了。这是拯救村子的((唯一))办法。

English: Some towns dry up, it's just the way it is.
Chinese: 有些镇子就是会衰败,世道如此。

English: That's e-e-easy for you to say, not being from here. Pwyll is the only place I've ever known. I won't ((survive)) anywhere else.
Chinese: 你——你说得轻巧,你又不是本地人。普威尔是我唯一熟悉的地方。去别处我((活不下去))。

English: @@ You don't know that. The Skyrealms are full of impossible places, beyond your ((wildest)) dreams.
Chinese: @@ 你怎么知道。天空领域遍地是难以置信的奇景,超越你((最狂野))的想象。

English: && I don't ((care)) about other places. I only have one home, and it's ((Pwyll)).
Chinese: && 别的地方我((不在乎))。我只有一个家,那就是((普威尔))。

English: %% <<He sniffs.>> I once tried some scryshroom tea, while my mother was out. I saw... I saw myself on a ship, flying through a shoal of skyfish, their scales shimmering in a rainbow of colour...
Chinese: %% <<他吸了吸鼻子。>>有一次母亲出门,我偷偷试了点窥菇茶。我看见……我看见自己在一条船上,穿过一群天鱼,它们的鳞片闪着彩虹般的光泽……

English: Mother always says the visions can be ((wrong)). So I thought it ((was)). But maybe... maybe it could be true?
Chinese: 母亲总说幻象会((出错))。所以我以为那是((假的))。可也许……也许它会是真的?

English: Okay. ((Sniff.)) I'll go back, then.
Chinese: 好吧。((吸鼻子。))那我回去。

English: <<You slice through the membrane and a torrent of foul-smelling acid pours forth. Lludd slides out of the muck, coughing and spluttering.>>
Chinese: <<你割开膜层,一股恶臭的酸液喷涌而出。卢德从秽物中滑出来,咳嗽不止。>>

English: Thank you, newcomer. Let me recollect myself and... I'll make my own way back to town.
Chinese: 谢谢你,新来的。让我定定神,然后……我自己回镇上去。

English: <<As you turn to leave, a violent tremor engulfs the whole mushroom as its organs undulate in agony. You realise that by slicing into its bowels, you may have just [[killed]] this ancient thing.>>
Chinese: <<你转身欲走,整株蘑菇剧烈震颤,器官痛苦地蠕动。你意识到,割进它的内脏,你或许已经[[杀死]]了这古老的存在。>>

English: Enough of this. <Cut him loose.>
Chinese: 够了。<割开膜放他出来。>

English: So you ((really)) want to do this?
Chinese: 所以你((真))想这么做?

English: <<You slice through the membrane and a torrent of foul-smelling acid pours forth. Lludd slides out of the muck, coughing and spluttering.>>
Chinese: <<你割开膜层,一股恶臭的酸液喷涌而出。卢德从秽物中滑出来,咳嗽不止。>>

English: You had no r-r-right! ##<<He shivers.>> The first thing I've done, truly by ((myself)), and you've ruined it. You had no ((right))...
Chinese: 你无——无权这样做! ##<<他瑟瑟发抖。>>这是我头一件真正((靠自己))做成的事,你却毁了它。你无((权))……

English: People care about you, kid. You can't throw your life away.
Chinese: 有人在乎你,小子。你不能拿命去扔。

English: I thought... mother would be ((proud))...  ##<<The boy shivers and says no more.>>
Chinese: 我以为……母亲会((骄傲))…… ##<<男孩瑟瑟发抖,不再说话。>>

English: You'll thank me in time.
Chinese: 早晚你会谢谢我的。

English: I just like ruining people's plans.
Chinese: 我就是喜欢毁掉别人的计划。

English: <<The boy shivers and says nothing.>>
Chinese: <<男孩瑟瑟发抖,一言不发。>>

English: So you ((really)) want to do this? Knowing that you'll die?
Chinese: 所以你((真))想这么做?明知会死?

English: I've never been so sure of ((anything)) in my life. I want to save the village - I want Pwyll to live on, even if I have to die.
Chinese: 我这辈子从没对((任何事))这么确定过。我想拯救村子——我想让普威尔活下去,哪怕我必须死。

English: Well, I respect your decision.
Chinese: 好吧,我尊重你的决定。

English: Thank you. I'm glad, at least someone took me seriously, in the e-e-end. Can I ask you a final favour?
Chinese: 谢谢你。我很欣慰,至少最后有人把我当——当回事了。能请你帮我最后一个忙吗?

English: Of course.
Chinese: 当然。

English: <<A hand pushes out from the membrane, slick with slime.>> Will you... hold my hand? ##<<You nod, and take his hand in your own. The sting of acid bites, and you feel him shiver.>>
Chinese: <<一只手从膜中伸出,黏液淋漓。>>你愿意……握住我的手吗? ##<<你点点头,握住他的手。酸液的刺痛咬人,你感到他在发抖。>>

English: <<You stay like this for a few moments, in silence, before his hand goes limp. You realise that Lludd is dead.>>
Chinese: <<你们就这样静静待了片刻,然后他的手垂软下去。你意识到,卢德死了。>>

English: No.
Chinese: 不。

English: That's okay. Then will you at least... wait here, with me?
Chinese: 没关系。那你至少能……陪我在这儿等等吗?

English: <<You nod and wait in silence for a few moments, until you notice the boy has gone very still. Yes, there's no denying it; Lludd is dead.>>
Chinese: <<你点点头,静静等了片刻,直到你发觉男孩已然一动不动。是的,毫无疑问;卢德死了。>>

English: <<There's no denying it; Lludd is dead.>>
Chinese: <<毫无疑问;卢德死了。>>

English: Still, I can't let you do this.
Chinese: 可我还是不能让你这么做。

English: Oh, it's you. ##I wanted to thank you, for what you did back in the Sacred Shroom. You saved my life.
Chinese: 哦,是你。 ##我想谢谢你,感谢你在神圣蘑菇里做的一切。你救了我的命。

English: I don't know what will happen to Pwyll. It makes me sad to think of it not being here, in the future... but maybe we can find somewhere else to call home.
Chinese: 我不知道普威尔将来会怎样。想到它将来不在这儿了,我就难过……但也许我们能找个别的地方当家。

English: Oh, it's you. ##I still can't forgive you, for interrupting the digestion. But seeing how relieved my mother was to have me back... I suppose I wasn't as worthless as I thought.
Chinese: 哦,是你。 ##我仍然无法原谅你,坏了我被消化的过程。但看到母亲迎我回家时如释重负的样子……我想我并非自己想的那么一无是处。

English: I don't know what will happen to Pwyll. It makes me sad to think of it not being here, in the future... but maybe we can find somewhere else to call home.
Chinese: 我不知道普威尔将来会怎样。想到它将来不在这儿了,我就难过……但也许我们能找个别的地方当家。

English: <<The man's eyes follow you with suspicion. His greying hair and weathered skin suggest he is older than most in the village, and a faded scar runs down his face.>>
Chinese: <<那男人的目光满腹狐疑地跟着你。花白的头发和饱经风霜的皮肤显示他比村里多数人都年长,一道褪色的伤疤划过脸庞。>>

English: Y're new to town, I gather? Well, I'm the local weighmaster - name's Culwych. And I'll have you know; before you engage in any business here in Pwyll, I'll be takin' yer weight.
Chinese: 我看你是新来的?嗯,我是本地秤量官——名叫卡尔威奇。你给我记住;在普威尔做任何买卖之前,我都得先给你过秤。

English: So, without another word, please step on the scales. <<He gestures to the huge contraption behind him.>> Thankin' ye ((kindly)).
Chinese: 所以,别废话,请上秤。<<他指指身后那台巨大的装置。>>多谢((配合))。

English: Wait, why do you want to ((weigh)) me?
Chinese: 等等,你为什么要给((我))过秤?

English: <<He narrows his eyes.>> By decree of the Apostatic Union, all those seekin' to trade in its jurisdictions must prove they're of an ((ordinary)) disposition; that is, not physically altered by cipher magic or god devotion, nor bearing the guilt of unpunished crimes.
Chinese: <<他眯起眼睛。>>奉叛教联盟法令,凡欲在其辖境内经商者,必须证明自己((寻常))无异;也就是说,未被密文魔法或拜神行径改变肉身,亦无未受惩罚的罪愆在身。

English: And you can tell that just by my ((weight))?
Chinese: 光凭我的((体重))你就能看出这些?

English: Just step on the godsdamn scales, alright?
Chinese: 快上那该死的秤,行不行?

English: Alright, I suppose.
Chinese: 行吧,照做便是。

English: <<He nods.>> Go ahead, then.
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>那就请吧。

English: There's no way I'm stepping on that thing.
Chinese: 我才不上那玩意呢。

English: Well, you're welcome to refuse; but this village will be having nothin' to do with ye until you step on those damn scales.
Chinese: 嗯,你尽管拒绝;但不上那该死的秤,这村子跟你没得谈。

English: As I already told ye, please step on the scales. <<He gestures to the huge contraption behind him.>>
Chinese: 已经跟你说过了,请上秤。<<他指指身后那台巨大的装置。>>

English: <<He studies the dials and symbols atop the machine, and scratches various notes on some parchment.>> ##Interesting. ((Very)) interesting.
Chinese: <<他端详着机器顶上的表盘与符号,在羊皮纸上草草记下各种笔记。>> ##有意思。((非常))有意思。

English: Uh... did I pass?
Chinese: 呃……我过关了吗?

English: ((Say nothing.))
Chinese: ((一言不发。))

English: The prime glyph says you're a... ((criminal)). <<He shoots you a stern glance.>> The lesser glyphs are harder to parse. Let's see now...
Chinese: 主符文说你是个……((罪犯))。<<他狠狠瞪你一眼。>>次级符文就难解了。让我看看……

English: They say you ((killed a man)). Multiple witnesses. And, what's this - ((martial trauma)). ## <<He sighs.>> I'm sorry to say I've known plenty o' soldiers who lost their reason.
Chinese: 上面说你((杀过人))。证人多名。还有,这是什么——((战阵创伤))。 ##<<他叹了口气。>>很遗憾,我认识不少丧失理智的老兵。

English: Says here y'er a ((deserter)). Don't say what from - these glyphs can be plenty vague. Still, can't say I blame anyone for running from a fight.
Chinese: 这儿写着你是((逃兵))。没说从哪儿逃——这些符文含糊得很。不过,打仗开溜,我也不能怪谁。

English: Hmm, I think this one's... ((fatal miscast)). Ah, so you're a dabbler in cipher magic, eh? A dangerous art, for certain. <<He pauses.>> Jus' be sure to keep any spellbooks ((closed)) in here, alright? I won't have you blowin' your fingers off in my vicinity.
Chinese: 嗯,这个是……((致命施法事故))。啊,原来你玩过密文魔法?无疑是门危险的技艺。<<他顿了顿。>>在这儿可千万把法术书((合上)),行吗?别在我跟前把手指崩飞了。

English: Hmm, illegal merchant. The goods seem to be- let's see - ((martial)) in nature. So you were an arms dealer, eh?
Chinese: 嗯,非法商贩。货品似乎是——让我看看——((军用))物资。所以你是个军火贩子?

English: Says here you were a petty criminal. The other glyphs say - hmm, let's see - you were found all beaten up. I assume you were betrayed by your own sort, eh? Serves you right.
Chinese: 这儿写着你是个小罪犯。其他符文说——嗯,让我看看——你被发现时遍体鳞伤。我猜是被自己人出卖了吧?活该。

English: They say you were a petty criminal. Other glyphs say you were tracked for years. Did you know that, I wonder? Did you live with one eye over yer shoulder?
Chinese: 上面说你是个小罪犯。其他符文说你被追缉多年。这你知道吗?你是不是天天提心吊胆过日子?

English: Crimes of a... ((magical)) nature. Says here you forced entry onto an Inquisition ship, via a... ((portal))? You're either the smartest or stupidest wizard I've ever heard of.
Chinese: 性质……((魔法))的罪行。这儿写着你强行闯上一艘宗教裁判所的船,经由一个……((传送门))?你要么是我听说过的最聪明、要么是最蠢的法师。

English: Hmm, plenty of damning glyphs 'ere. Seems like you were some sorta criminal ringleader. No wonder you were caught.
Chinese: 嗯,这儿的定罪符文可不少。看来你是什么犯罪头目。难怪被抓。

English: Hm, what's this? ((Raider)) of... ((tombs))? Ah, so y'er in the business of plunderin' ancient relics, eh? Very dangerous - an' not to mention illegal.
Chinese: 嗯,这是什么?((盗))……((古墓))的贼?啊,原来你是干盗掘古代遗物这行的?非常危险——更别提违法了。

English: ((Forbidden cipher)), eh? Ah, so you stumbled on one o' those ((illegal)) words? A strange crime no doubt, but one with good reason. You don't wanna be blowing up a town just 'cos you mispronounced one o' those.
Chinese: ((禁咒)),嗯?啊,所以你撞上了某个((非法))之词?罪名无疑古怪,但设禁有理。你可不想就因为读错一个词,把整座镇子炸上天。

English: Says here you caused a ((cipher rift)). I can't imagine what kinda foul cipheristry you were dabblin' with, but I'm mighty glad you didn't tear apart the skyrealms with your foolishness.
Chinese: 这儿写着你在((密文))上撕出过裂隙。我无法想象你捣鼓的是何等污秽的密文邪术,但我非常庆幸你没用自己的蠢把天空领域撕个粉碎。

English: Merchant of ((illegal goods)). Let's see here, you were tradin'... ((books))? Hmph, may seem innocent enough, but some dusty ol' tomes are more dangerous than a broadside of cannons.
Chinese: ((违禁))商贩。让我看看,你交易的是……((书))?哼,看似无害,但有些积灰的古书比一轮舷炮齐射还危险。

English: Hmm - ((corruption)). An' this glyph says - politics? Ah, so you probably rigged an election, right? I've 'eard those things can be brutal affairs with plenty o' bloodshed, so I can see why some would take a fall for the right price.
Chinese: 嗯——((贪腐))。而这个符文说——政治?啊,所以你八成操纵过选举,对吧?我听说那种事狠辣得很,免不了流血,所以有人肯为好价钱顶罪,我也理解。

English: Says here you're of ((noble)) blood. An', this is a strange glyph - I think it means ((disgrace))? Ah, so you're probably a runaway from one o' those corrupt noble families.
Chinese: 这儿写着你是((贵族))血统。还有,这个符文很怪——我想是((耻辱))?啊,所以你八成是从哪个腐化贵族家里跑出来的。

English: Well, this is a strange series of glyphs. Multiple... disrobings... through cipher? <<He thinks a moment, then erupts in hearty laughter.>> ##Oh, I heard about you. You're that idiot who turned a whole town naked, am I right?
Chinese: 嗯,这一串符文真怪。多起……借密文……扒衣案?<<他想了想,随即放声大笑。>> ##哦,我听说过你。你就是把整座镇子扒光了的那个蠢货,对吧?

English: They say you were a merchant - an' a wealthy one, at that. But this glyph means... ((forbidden relics))? Ah, so you were in the business of the ((occult)). No wonder they caught you.
Chinese: 上面说你是个商人——还是个有钱的。但这个符文的意思是……((禁物))?啊,所以你干的是((秘术))营生。难怪被抓。

English: Ah, but there's one more glyph. Inquisition... ((agent))? ##<<He looks up from his parchment, his face struck with puzzlement.>>
Chinese: 啊,还有一个符文。宗教裁判所……((探员))? ##<<他从羊皮纸上抬起头,满脸困惑。>>

English: Beggin' yer pardon -  at first glance I thought you might be one o' those Dark Star mercenaries, running from the Inquisition raid. But you must 'ave been ((fighting)) those scoundrels, eh?
Chinese: 恕我失礼——乍一看我还以为你是哪个黑星佣兵,躲避宗教裁判所突袭呢。但你一定是((打))那些恶棍的,对吧?

English: Yes, those crimes were just... uh... a ((cover story)).
Chinese: 对,那些罪名只是……呃……((掩护身份))。

English: <<He gives a quick Union salute.>> Apologies, friend. This 'umble weighmaster didn't mean to delay Inquisition business with his lowly bureaucracy. ##I've approved your visit to Pwyll; you won't get any trouble.
Chinese: <<他行了个利落的联盟礼。>>抱歉,朋友。我这卑微的秤量官可无意用小吏的繁文缛节耽搁宗教裁判所的公务。 ##你访问普威尔的手续我已批准;不会有人找你麻烦。

English: Yes, I'm a Confessor, atoning for my crimes.
Chinese: 对,我是个忏悔者,正在为自己的罪行赎罪。

English: It's not by choice, I assure you.
Chinese: 我向你保证,这并非我自愿。

English: Well, far be it for me to delay Inquisition business. ##I've approved your visit to Pwyll; you won't get any trouble.
Chinese: 嗯,我哪敢耽搁宗教裁判所的公务。 ##你访问普威尔的手续我已批准;不会有人找你麻烦。

English: <<He thinks a moment.>> But, uh, say - in light of your ((profession)) - could lend this 'umble servant of the Apostatic Union a hand? There'd be an [[Apostatic Union Passport]] in it, for ye...
Chinese: <<他想了想。>>不过,呃,我说——看在你的((职业))份上——能帮叛教联盟这个卑微仆人一把吗?事成之后,有张[[叛教联盟护照]]等着你……

English: Y'see, the Inquisition raid ain't the ((only)) reason we've been so eager to weigh people of late. There's also fears of bloody ((god-worship)) among the townsfolk. After all we've been through! <<He looks distinctly peeved.>>
Chinese: 你瞧,近来我们急着给人过秤,可((不单))是为了宗教裁判所突袭。镇民中还担心出现该死的((拜神))勾当。我们都经历过那些了!<<他一脸恼火。>>

English: Ah, welcome back. What can ol' Culwych do for ye?
Chinese: 啊,欢迎回来。老卡尔威奇能为你做点什么?

English: I'm looking for some Dark Star mercs, and I need to explore the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 我在找几个黑星佣兵,而且我需要走遍梦幻群岛。

English: <<Culwych taps his nose.>> Ah, ((Inquisition)) business, eh? Don't worry, ol' Culwych can keep a secret.
Chinese: <<卡尔威奇点了点鼻子。>>啊,((宗教裁判所))的公务,嗯?放心,老卡尔威奇守得住秘密。

English: Well, you might try askin' [[Nudd]] who's the hired muscle over at the [[Scryshroom Company]]. Gotta say, he's a prickly fella an' I've never gotten on with him too well, but I know he used to work for the Dark Stars.
Chinese: 嗯,你可以去问问[[纳德]],[[窥菇公司]]雇的打手。说实话,那家伙一身刺,我一直跟他不对付,但我知道他从前替黑星佣兵团干过活。

English: But to be honest, I doubt you'll find out much in ol' Pwyll. You'll be wantin' to reach [[Hallow Town]] in [[Hallowshire]], to the south. There's a Union Council building an' a bustling dock where all sorta skyships lay anchor.
Chinese: 但说实话,在老普威尔恐怕查不出多少。你得南下,去[[哈洛郡]]的[[哈洛镇]]。那儿有联盟议事厅,还有个热闹的码头,各路天船都停泊。

English: But to pass over the Union Gatebridge you'll need an [[Apostatic Union Passport]]. Each one'll grant you passage over a single bridge.
Chinese: 但要过联盟关卡桥,你需要一张[[叛教联盟护照]]。每张护照只能过一座桥。

English: As a certified weighmaster, I have one that I'm not usin' - but Inquisitor or not, you'll have to [[earn my trust]] if I'm gonna just hand it over.
Chinese: 作为认证秤量官,我手里有一张闲置的——但不管你是不是审判官,要想让我白白交出来,你得先[[赢得我的信任]]。

English: What can you tell me about this town?
Chinese: 关于这个镇子,你能告诉我什么?

English: Well, Pwyll is a quaint village these days. We've been growin' and sellin' [[scryshroom]] since the early days of the Skyrealms, an' shippin' 'em all over the place.
Chinese: 嗯,如今的普威尔是个古雅的小村。自天空领域开辟之初,我们就种[[窥菇]]、卖窥菇,运往四面八方。

English: Business may not be as good since the [[God War]] - ((killin' yer own deity will do that)) -  but we're better off for being in the Apostatic Union. I'd take the Union's tax levies over a Wikkan blood contract any day.
Chinese: 自[[神之战]]后生意可能不复当年——((弑神的代价便是如此))——但身在叛教联盟,我们的日子好过多了。联盟的税收和维坎血契之间,我任何时候都选前者。

English: Wait - you killed your own god?
Chinese: 等等——你们杀了自己的神?

English: Aye, forty years ago. Before then Pwyll was prosperous - and ((miserable)). We were trapped into a blood-contract with our tyrant-god Aenguin, and the terms were ((abysmal)).
Chinese: 对,四十年前。在那之前,普威尔富足——也((悲惨))。我们被一纸血契捆在我们的暴君神安圭因身上,条款((糟透了))。

English: Oh, our harvest was bountiful, but the blood-price was high. Every year, dozens o' villagers disappeared into the [[sacred shrooms]] to appease that divine ((bastard)), never to be seen again.
Chinese: 哦,我们收成是丰饶,可血的代价高昂。每年都有几十个村民被送进[[神圣蘑菇]],去平息那位神圣((杂种))的怒火,从此杳无音信。

English: So when the Apostatics came callin' - askin' us to renounce our faith, an' join the fight against the Wikkans? We took up arms ((gladly)). I fought in the Pwyllian division, an' have the scars to show for it.
Chinese: 所以当叛教者找上门——要我们背弃信仰、加入讨伐维坎教徒的战事?我们((欣然))拿起了武器。我打过普威尔师团,身上疤就是证明。

English: What happened next?
Chinese: 后来呢?

English: Okay, I get the picture.
Chinese: 行,我明白了。

English: Anythin' else you wanted?
Chinese: 还想问什么?

English: We crewed a Kardovan lancer ship an' impaled our own deity with a voidspear. For all the grief he caused my people, that bugger really didn't put up much of a fight.
Chinese: 我们登上一艘卡尔多瓦长矛船,用虚空长矛把自己的神钉了个对穿。他给我族人带来那么多苦难,那家伙却没怎么挣扎。

English: But the war still raged, so the Apostatics built that huge [[fortress]] on the hill to repel Wikkan counterattacks. O' course, when the dust cleared an' the war was over, the newfangled [[Apostatic Union]] let it fall into ruin...
Chinese: 但战事仍在肆虐,叛教者便在山上建起那座巨大的[[堡垒]],抵御维坎教徒的反扑。当然,硝烟散尽、战事平息后,新兴的[[叛教联盟]]任它沦为废墟……

English: ...until that mercenary lass ((Vela Callose)) took it over, o' course. Past few years, Pwyll 'as garnered quite the reputation for smugglin' and nefarious business, thanks to those damned [[Dark Stars]]. You'd think the Union would'a done somethin' about it sooner, but the larger the gears the slower they grind, I guess.
Chinese: ……直到那佣兵丫头((薇拉·卡洛斯))接手,当然。这几年,拜那些该死的[[黑星佣兵团]]所赐,普威尔在走私和不光彩行当上名声在外。你会觉得联盟早该管管了,不过我想,齿轮越大转得越慢嘛。

English: ...until that mercenary lass ((Vela Callose)) took it over, o' course. Past few years, Pwyll 'as garnered quite the reputation for smugglin' and nefarious business, thanks to those damned [[Dark Stars]].
Chinese: ……直到那佣兵丫头((薇拉·卡洛斯))接手,当然。这几年,拜那些该死的[[黑星佣兵团]]所赐,普威尔在走私和不光彩行当上可是名声在外。

English: You'd think the Union would'a done somethin' about it sooner, but the larger the gears the slower they grind, I guess.
Chinese: 你会觉得联盟早该管管了,不过我想,齿轮越大转得越慢嘛。

English: What's a Wikkan contract?
Chinese: 什么是维坎契约?

English: Hmph, 'ave things gotten so comfy in the Union that people 'ave forgotten their ((history?)) Well I'll be damned.
Chinese: 哼,联盟的日子过得太舒坦,连自己的((历史?))都忘了?真是见鬼。

English: For as long as people can remember, Wikkans 'ave acted as mediators between god's an' their worshippers. ##<<He strokes his chin.>> Kinda like ((lawyers)) of the ((divine)), I guess.
Chinese: 自有记忆以来,维坎教徒就一直充当神明与其信徒之间的中介。 ##<<他摸着下巴。>>大概算是((神明))的((律师))吧。

English: S'pposedly they acted in the best interests of both mortals ((an')) the gods - binding both in a magical contract that made sure neither got scuppered over. 'Cept, here in Pwyll our Wikkans ((fucked)) us; the terms were all in Aenguin's favour.
Chinese: 据说他们兼顾凡人((和))神明双方的利益——用一份魔法契约把双方绑在一起,确保谁也不会被坑。可是在普威尔,我们的维坎教徒((坑))了我们;契约条款全向着安圭因。

English: We can't a' been alone, because forty years ago the apostatics started the God War, and we weren't the ((only)) place to slay their own god, let me tell ya.
Chinese: 我们肯定不是孤例,因为四十年前叛教者们发动了神之战,而且我告诉你,弑神的((不只))我们一处。

English: Are you happy being part of the Apostatic Union?
Chinese: 身为叛教联盟的一员,你高兴吗?

English: More than a lotta folk. I've met travellers who lament the passing of the gods - who claim the Union has swapped divine majesty for naught but politics an' paperwork.
Chinese: 比很多人都高兴。我遇过些旅人,哀叹诸神陨落——声称联盟把神圣威仪换成了政治与文书,一无是处。

English: But here in Pwyll? Anyone old enough will remember the ((bad times.)) We've all lost friends an' family - the godsdamn soil was fertilised with their blood.
Chinese: 可在普威尔?凡是上了年纪的都记得那些((坏年月。))我们都失去了亲朋——那该死的土壤,都是用他们的血浇肥的。

English: Of course, for a long time bein' in the Union didn't mean much. Here in the [[Oneiric Isles]] we're on the fringes, y'see - an' for decades these isles were rife with outlaws, criminals and Wikkan refugees.
Chinese: 当然,很长一段时间里,加入联盟没多大意义。要知道,我们在[[梦幻群岛]],地处边缘——几十年来,这些岛上法外之徒、罪犯和维坎难民横行。

English: It's only lately that the Union's stepped up its presence an' built a council chamber in [[Hallowshire]]. Since then, trade in Pwyll's been boomin' - turns out plenty of folk wanna buy our shrooms. Now, If only our harvests could keep up with demand...
Chinese: 直到近来联盟才加强驻在,在[[哈洛郡]]建了议事厅。从那以后,普威尔的贸易蒸蒸日上——原来想买我们蘑菇的人多得很。唉,要是收成能跟上需求就好了……

English: What's this scryshroom you grow?
Chinese: 你们种的这窥菇是什么?

English: Well, it's a mushroom that lets you scry the future, see? Shows you visions of what ((could)) come to pass.
Chinese: 嗯,就是一种能让你窥视未来的蘑菇,懂吗?给你看那些((可能))成真的景象。

English: Only, it's not always right. Sure, every now an' again someone sees a vision of something that absolutely, irrevocably comes true, an' everyone sings the praises of the humble scryshroom. But most of the time y'er just havin' a bad dream.
Chinese: 只是它不总灵验。诚然,偶尔有人看到的幻象绝对、不可逆转地应验了,大家就把不起眼的窥菇夸上天。可大多数时候,你不过是做了场噩梦。

English: <<He shrugs.>> Still, people all over the Skyrealms wanna buy it, so I'm not complainin' - puts food on my plate, after all.
Chinese: <<他耸耸肩。>>不过,天空领域各地的人都想买,所以我没什么可抱怨的——毕竟它让我吃上了饭。

English: That's all I wanted to ask.
Chinese: 我想问的就这些。

English: So be it. Was there anythin' else?
Chinese: 那就这样。还有别的事吗?

English: How can you tell so much from those scales?
Chinese: 你从那杆秤上怎么能看出这么多名堂?

English: These are [[morality scales]]. You'll see there's only one visible; that's because it's magically linked at the fulcrum, through a bond of cipher, to a scale containin' the ((Moral Standard)).
Chinese: 这是[[道德秤]]。你会看到它只有一端可见;那是因为在支点处,它通过密文联结,与盛着((道德标杆))的另一端魔法相连。

English: What's the Moral Standard - some kind of weight?
Chinese: 道德标杆是什么——某种砝码?

English: <<He grins.>> Oh, no - that would be preposterous! How could you tell so much about a person by weighin' 'em against a ((dead weight))? No, no - don't be stupid!
Chinese: <<他咧嘴一笑。>>哦,不——那也太荒唐了!拿人跟一块((死砝码))较重,怎么能看出那么多门道?不,不——别犯傻!

English: The Moral Standard is a ((person)). A carefully selected person who bears qualities deemed the epitome of Apostatic Union morality. By weighin' you against such perfect integrity, we can tell by what ((degree)) your character is lackin'.
Chinese: 道德标杆是个((活人))。一位精心挑选的人,具备堪称叛教联盟道德典范的品质。拿你与这般完美的操守相较,我们就能看出你的品性((欠缺))几分。

English: I think the current Moral Standard resides far off in Byonne University. They have to rest an' sleep between weighings, of course - which is why weigh houses only open at certain times.
Chinese: 我记得现任道德标杆远在拜昂大学。称量之间,他们当然得休息睡觉——所以称量所只在特定时间开放。

English: Why does such a small town need to weigh people?
Chinese: 这么小的镇子,为什么要给人过秤?

English: Well, on account of bein' on the ((fringes)) of Apostatic Union territory, there are certain unseemly folk who've taken advantage of Pwyll in the past. Mercenaries like those Dark Stars in the fort over yonder, who've used us to smuggle ill-gotten goods into [[Hallowshire]] and beyond.
Chinese: 嗯,正因为地处叛教联盟疆域的((边缘)),过去总有些不三不四的人占普威尔的便宜。就像那边堡垒里的黑星佣兵,借我们的地方把赃货运进[[哈洛郡]]和更远处。

English: So havin' a certified weighmaster helps Pwyll attract reputable merchants to buy our [[scryshroom tea]]. Shows we can be trusted to pay our taxes, y'know?
Chinese: 所以有位认证秤量官,能帮普威尔招徕信誉良好的商人来买我们的[[窥菇茶]]。这表明我们交税守信,你懂吧?

English: An', we don't ((just)) weigh people. Can also weigh shrooms an' grain. Or, well, anythin' really.
Chinese: 还有,我们((不只))给人过秤。也称蘑菇和谷物。呃,其实是啥都称。

English: That's enough about weighing things.
Chinese: 称重的事就问到这儿。

English: Was there anythin' else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗?

English: I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 那我先走了。

English: Aye, until next time.
Chinese: 行,下次见。

English: So you need help tracking down god-worshippers?
Chinese: 所以你需要帮忙追查拜神者?

English: <<He leans forward and speaks low.>> ((Aye.)) Folk've been a-feared recently, y'see. The soil's dyin' an' harvests are down. Merchants want to buy our scryshroom more than ever, but we can't meet demand. So some have been flirtin' with... the ((old)) ways.
Chinese: <<他俯身低语。>>((是。))最近乡亲们都怕了,你瞧。土壤在死,收成在跌。商人想买我们窥菇的劲头前所未有,可我们供不上货。所以有些人开始跟……((老))法子眉来眼去了。

English: What makes the ((old)) ways so bad?
Chinese: ((老))法子有什么不好?

English: <<He sighs.>> It's been forty years since the God War. Forty years since the apostatics told the Wikkans an' their gods to go ((fuck)) 'emselves. ##Forty years since me an' the lads drove a voidspear through our ((own god's)) eye - that cruel, violent, ((bastard)) of a god: Aenguin.
Chinese: <<他叹了口气。>>神之战已经过去四十年。叛教者叫维坎教徒和他们的神((滚蛋)),也过去四十年了。 ##我和弟兄们把虚空长矛捅进((我们自己的神))的眼窝,也四十年了——那个残暴嗜血的((杂种))神:安圭因。

English: An' in those forty years, folk 'ave forgotten how ((bad)) it was under that divine tyrant an' his Wikkan lackeys. Sure, we had bountiful harvests and our purses were bulgin'. But our sons and daughters were taken from us, an' the soil was fertilised with their ((blood)).
Chinese: 而在这四十年里,乡亲们忘了在那位神圣暴君和他的维坎走狗治下,日子((多惨))。诚然,那时我们收成丰饶,钱袋鼓鼓。可我们的儿女被夺走,土壤是用他们的((血))浇肥的。

English: Now, our ol' god Aenguin's been ((dead)) for long enough. But they say so long as people still ((believe)), some part of a god can live on. So there's been ((murmuring)) of some folk tryin' to... bring him ((back,)) an' that's got the rest o' us so scared shitless.
Chinese: 如今,我们的老神安圭因((死))得够久了。但人们说,只要还有人((信)),神的一部分就能活下去。所以有((风声))说,有些人正试图……让他((复活,))这让我们其他人吓得魂飞魄散。

English: Look, just tell me what you need.
Chinese: 行了,直接说你需要什么。

English: Alright, I'll tell it straight. As you know, god-worship an' consortin' with Wikkans or their gods is a heinous crime - but I've reason to believe there's some among us who are turnin' to it, to try an' fix our poor harvests.
Chinese: 好,我就直说。你知道,拜神、与维坎教徒或他们的神勾结是滔天大罪——但我有理由相信,我们中间有人正转向此道,想补救可怜的收成。

English: Trouble with a small town like this? We all know each other, an' the guilty parties won't talk to ((me)). But ((you))? You're an outsider, an' an Inquisition ((agent)) to boot.
Chinese: 这种小镇的难处?大家彼此都认识,那些罪人不会跟((我))开口。可((你))?你是外乡人,还是宗教裁判所的((探员))。

English: I need you to [[ask around]], an' try and find any [[Wikkan sympathisers]] - so we can sort this out ((quiet)) like, before the villagers start loppin' each others heads off in a frenzy. ##Find summin' out and I'll dispense you a [[Union Passport]] that'll grant passage to Hallowshire.
Chinese: 我需要你[[四处打听]],设法找出任何[[维坎同情者]]——好让我们悄悄把这事((摆平)),免得乡亲们杀红了眼互相砍脑袋。 ##查出点什么,我就发你一张[[联盟护照]],凭它可以去哈洛郡。

English: Alright, I'll see what I can do.
Chinese: 好,我尽力而为。

English: <<He sighs in relief.>> You have my ((thanks)), newcomer. Just... as soon as you find summin' out of sorts, you let me know, y'hear?
Chinese: <<他如释重负地叹了口气。>>新来的,我((感谢))你。只是……一发现什么不对劲,你就告诉我,听见没?

English: I get the whole ((god)) thing, but what exactly ((is)) a Wikkan?
Chinese: ((神))的事我懂了,可维坎教徒((到底))是什么?

English: I'll think about it.
Chinese: 我考虑考虑。

English: <<He sighs.>> Look... if you hear of summin' out of sorts, just let me know, y'hear?
Chinese: <<他叹了口气。>>听着……一听说什么不对劲,就告诉我,听见没?

English: So, about these god-worshippers...
Chinese: 那么,关于这些拜神者……

English: <<He leans in.>> You heard anythin'?
Chinese: <<他凑近。>>你听到什么了吗?

English: What makes the old ways so bad, exactly?
Chinese: 老法子究竟有什么不好?

English: Do you have any idea who I should be asking?
Chinese: 你觉得我该去问谁?

English: <<He strokes his chin.>> Well, you could try our Mayor, Owynn, but... honestly, she's often got her head so far in the clouds, I doubt she 'as a clue what's going on with her constituents.
Chinese: <<他摸着下巴。>>嗯,你可以去找我们镇长奥尔温,不过……说实话,她经常神游天外,我怀疑她对镇民的事一无所知。

English: But seein' as this whole thing's tied up with the shroom trade, I'd try asking around in the [[Scryshroom Company]] down by the dock. Its owner, [[Dwynn]], certainly has a lot to ((gain)) from better harvests...
Chinese: 不过这事儿既然跟蘑菇生意纠缠不清,我建议去码头边的[[窥菇公司]]打听打听。它的东家[[德温]],收成好转他((好处))可不少……

English: About these Sacred Shrooms...
Chinese: 关于这些神圣蘑菇……

English: That's all.
Chinese: 就这些。

English: Fair 'nuff.
Chinese: 有道理。

English: I've found evidence of god-worship in Pwyll.
Chinese: 我发现了普威尔有人拜神的证据。

English: <<He leans close.>> Oh yeah? ((Tell)) me then, why don't ya?
Chinese: <<他凑近。>>哦是吗?那你倒是((说))说看?

English: I saw someone dressed in robes, lurking around at night.
Chinese: 我看见有人身穿长袍,夜里四处鬼祟。

English: Hmm, that sure is mighty suspicious - but on its own, I can't do nought with this kinda evidence. Can ye try an' find where they were ((goin'?)) If they really ((were)) a Wikkan, there'd be some sorta... ((ritual)), maybe. Signs of someone tryin' ta rekindle the contract...
Chinese: 嗯,这确实非常可疑——但光凭这个,这种证据我做不了什么。你能设法找到他们((去了哪儿?))要是真((是))维坎教徒,那总该有什么……((仪式))吧。比如有人想重续契约的迹象……

English: There were occult instruments in the caverns below Pwyll.
Chinese: 普威尔地下的洞穴里有秘术法器。

English: <<For a moment, he merely stares past you; lost in thought.>> ##This can only mean one thing.
Chinese: <<一时间,他只是望着你身后出神。>> ##这只意味着一件事。

English: If someone's conductin' rituals around Aenguin's corpse, that means they're tryin' to re-open the blood contract. ##But buried in those clauses was a ((terrible cost))... no less than [[human sacrifice]].
Chinese: 要是有人在安圭因的尸身旁举行仪式,那就是想重开血契。 ##而契约条款里埋着一笔((可怕的代价))……正是[[活人献祭]]。

English: Here, take [[this key]]. It'll unlock the upper chamber in the [[Sacred Shroom to the west]].
Chinese: 给,拿着[[这把钥匙]]。它能打开[[西边神圣蘑菇]]的上层密室。

English: That [[key]] you found? It'll unlock the upper chamber in the [[Sacred Shroom to the west]].
Chinese: 你找到的那把[[钥匙]]?它能打开[[西边神圣蘑菇]]的上层密室。

English: There's no doubt in my mind. Someone's bein' taken to the Sacred Shroom to be metabolised - as per the contract's terms. ##You gotta [[go there an' ((save 'em!))]]
Chinese: 我毫不怀疑。有人正被带往神圣蘑菇,按契约条款去被消化吸收。 ##你得[[去那儿((救出他们!))]]

English: Did you say ((metabolised))?
Chinese: 你说((消化吸收))?

English: In the old days, there were Sacred Shrooms all over Pwyll. Each would spawn a whole forest 'o scryshrooms, but only... only if they'd recently metabolised a human.
Chinese: 古时候,普威尔遍地是神圣蘑菇。每一株都能孕育出整片窥菇林,但只有……只有在它们新近消化过一个活人之后。

English: I 'aint sure if the scryshrooms ((use)) part of the human body to achieve their effect, or whether it was all just part o' Aenguin's divine ((mockery)) - but I know the scryshrooms used t'be more potent in the old days.
Chinese: 我拿不准窥菇是不是((用))人体的某部分来达成药效,还是这一切只是安圭因神圣的((嘲弄))——但我知道,从前的窥菇药劲更大。

English: Now, there's only one Sacred Shroom left - deep in the mushroom forest to the west. All the others shrivelled up an' died when we stopped feedin' 'em flesh.
Chinese: 如今,只剩一株神圣蘑菇了——在西边蘑菇林深处。我们不再喂它们血肉之后,其余的都枯死了。

English: How do I get into this... mushroom?
Chinese: 我怎么进到这……蘑菇里头?

English: Well, you'll need to travel through the mushroom forest. You can't miss the shroom itself; it's prolly the biggest mushroom you've ever seen.
Chinese: 嗯,你得穿过蘑菇林。菇本身你绝不会错过;大概是你这辈子见过最大的蘑菇。

English: On account o' it bein used by the Wikkans in the past, there's doors an' paths leadin' up around the shroom itself. The [[main doors]] will lead you through the central stem; but there might be a whole host o' nasty monsters waitin' to tear you a new one.
Chinese: 因为维坎教徒从前用过它,菇身周围有门有路直通而上。[[正门]]会领你穿过中央菇柄;不过可能有一大群恶心的怪物候着,要把你撕个稀烂。

English: So you might try lookin' for a [[way round the back]]. It'll prolly be locked up tight, but you might have less o' a fight on yer hands that way.
Chinese: 所以你可以试试找找[[后山的小路]]。多半锁得死死的,但那样你手上要打的架可能少些。

English: Okay, I'll do my best.
Chinese: 好,我尽力。

English: I'm relyin' on you, y'hear?
Chinese: 我可全指望你了,听见没?

English: I visited the Sacred Shroom and discovered what's going on.
Chinese: 我去了神圣蘑菇,查明了其中的勾当。

English: Was I right? Was there a ((sacrifice)) takin' place?
Chinese: 我说得对吗?那里在进行((献祭))?

English: It was Lludd. He sacrificed himself so that Pwyll would prosper.
Chinese: 是卢德。他献祭了自己,好让普威尔兴旺。

English: <<Culwych staggers back, aghast.>> Oh, not poor ((Lludd))? I was there at his ((namin')), looked after that lad like he was... <<He chokes on the words.>>
Chinese: <<卡尔威奇踉跄后退,惊骇不已。>>哦,不会是可怜的((卢德))吧?他((命名礼))时我就在场,那孩子我看着长大,就像……<<他哽住了。>>

English: Oh, that ((foolish)) boy. The harvests ain't worth Aenguin's ((blood price))-  ain't I always taught 'im that?
Chinese: 哦,这((傻))孩子。收成哪值得安圭因的((血的代价))——我不是一直这么教他的吗?

English: <<He sighs heavily.>> Still, I s'pose you got to the bottom o' what's been goin' on, an' for that you have my thanks.
Chinese: <<他重重叹了口气。>>不过,你总算把这里的勾当查了个水落石出,为此我感谢你。

English: It was Lludd. He tried to sacrifice himself, but I managed to talk him down.
Chinese: 是卢德。他试图献祭自己,但我把他劝住了。

English: <<Culwych gasps.>> Oh, that ((foolish)) boy! The harvests ain't worth Aenguin's ((blood price)) -  ain't I always taught 'im that?
Chinese: <<卡尔威奇倒吸一口气。>>哦,这((傻))孩子!收成哪值得安圭因的((血的代价))——我不是一直这么教他的吗?

English: But looks like you ((stopped)) him, newcomer; and for that you have my sincerest thanks. It's not much, but just as I promised...
Chinese: 不过看来你((拦住))了他,新来的;为此我由衷感谢。东西不多,但正如我答应的……

English: Here, take this [[Union Passport]]. It'll get you through the [[gatebridge to the south]], leadin' to [[Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 给,收下这张[[联盟护照]]。它能让你通过[[南边的关卡桥]],通往[[哈洛郡]]。

English: Be careful down there, mind. If you think Pwyll's harvests are bad, you ain't see ((nothing)) yet. Hallowshire's in the midst of an awful famine, an' it seems the townsfolk 'an our poor Lludd 'ave had certain... ((ideas)) in common.
Chinese: 下面可要当心。要是你觉得普威尔的收成已经够糟,那你还没见过((更糟))的。哈洛郡正闹着可怕的饥荒,看来镇上的乡亲和我们可怜的卢德想到了一处……((不谋而合))。

English: I found Wikkan antiques in Mayor Olwen's basement.
Chinese: 我在奥尔温镇长的地下室发现了维坎古董。

English: <<He strokes his chin and groans.>> ((Olwen)) you say? Could it be...?
Chinese: <<他摸着下巴,哼了一声。>>你说((奥尔温))?莫非是……?

English: <<He shakes his head.>> But we'll need more to go on than jus' this - plenty o' these old houses have things knockin' about in 'em that'd make a Wikkan blush. I don't want to jump to conclusions; so we'll need ((more.))
Chinese: <<他摇摇头。>>但光凭这个还不够——这些老房子里,能让维坎教徒脸红的东西多得是。我不想妄下结论;所以我们需要((更多))证据。

English: Y'know, folk around here ain't stupid. I reckon any shady goings on will be happening under the [[cover of darkness]]. Why don't you try [[resting]] until nightfall? I know Dwynn [[rents a room]] for passersby.
Chinese: 你知道吗,这附近的人可不傻。我看任何见不得光的勾当都会趁[[夜色掩护]]进行。你不如试试[[休息]]到天黑?我知道德温给过路人[[出租房间]]。

English: <<The woman sits with her eyes closed, a pained expression on her face. Various medallions and necklaces hang around her neck, suggesting she holds some important position here in Pwyll.>>
Chinese: <<那女人闭眼坐着,面露痛苦。她的脖子上挂着各式徽章与项链,显示她在普威尔身居要职。>>

English: <<She mutters under her breath:>> Flames, oh the ((flames))! We have to douse the ((flames))...
Chinese: <<她低声喃喃:>>火焰,哦那((火焰))!我们必须扑灭那((火焰))……

English: Uh, is everything okay?
Chinese: 呃,你还好吗?

English: ((Say nothing)).
Chinese: ((什么也不说))。

English: <<She continues to mutter to herself, shaking her head to and fro, until she startles herself awake.>>
Chinese: <<她继续喃喃自语,摇头晃脑,直到猛然惊醒。>>

English: Ahh! <<She looks at you with a frenzied intensity to her gaze.>> ##What are you doing? You've got to get ((out)) of here! The nautilob will ((burn you alive))!
Chinese: 啊!<<她目光狂乱地盯着你。>> ##你在干什么?你得((离开))这儿!鹦鹉螺妖会把你们((活活烧死))!

English: What are you talking about?
Chinese: 你在说什么呢?

English: Can't you ((see)) it? The monster rising above the flames? Oh, the ((horror...)) We have to...
Chinese: 你((看不见))吗?那从烈焰中升起的怪物?哦,多((可怕……))我们必须……

English: Nothing's on fire, lady.
Chinese: 女士,这儿什么都没着火。

English: You fool, even ((you)) are ablaze! Oh, how the skin melts from your bones! We have to...
Chinese: 蠢货,连((你))都在燃烧!哦,你的皮肉正从骨头上熔化!我们必须……

English: Not the ((nautilob))! Whatever's next - the ((phlanganip))?
Chinese: 别提((鹦鹉螺妖))了!下一个是什么——((弗拉加尼普))?

English: You ((jest)), but the giant nautilob is no ((joke))! What do you think caused all this devastation? We have to...
Chinese: 你((打趣)),可巨型鹦鹉螺妖绝不((好笑))!你觉得这场浩劫是谁造成的?我们必须……

English: <<She stops mid sentence and blinks, slowly. After a moment she says,>> ##...Nothing's on fire, is it?
Chinese: <<她话说一半,缓缓眨了眨眼。片刻后她说:>> ##……没着火,对吧?

English: No.
Chinese: 没。

English: Are you kidding? I'm burnt to a crisp.
Chinese: 开什么玩笑?我都烧成脆皮了。

English: Oh, how ((embarrassing))! I'm terribly sorry, you caught me in the middle of a divination. ##My name is [[Olwen]], mayor of this humble village of Pwyll. How do you do?
Chinese: 哦,真((难为情))!实在抱歉,你撞见我占卜占到一半了。 ##我叫[[奥尔温]],普威尔这座小小村落的镇长。幸会幸会?

English: Did you say ((divination))? Are we going to die?
Chinese: 你说((占卜))?我们要死了吗?

English: <<She chuckles nervously.>> Oh, by the Skyrealms, not at all! There is only a distinct ((possibility)) we will be burned alive.
Chinese: <<她紧张地轻笑。>>哦,天空领域在上,绝不会!只是存在一种显著的((可能性)):我们会被活活烧死。

English: Are hallucinogenic drugs part of your mayoral duties, or...?
Chinese: 迷幻药物也是镇长职责的一部分,还是……?

English: <<She blinks at you.>> Well... of ((course))! Hallucinogenic drugs are our main export here in Pwyll. It would be remiss of me not to partake!
Chinese: <<她冲你眨眨眼。>>呃……((当然))!迷幻药物是普威尔的主要出口商品。我不亲身尝试岂不是失职!

English: Pleased to meet you.
Chinese: 幸会幸会。

English: <<She performs a short curtsy.>> Thank you for your understanding. I've been rather anxious about the future, as you've no doubt observed...
Chinese: <<她微微屈膝行礼。>>多谢你的体谅。我最近对未来颇为焦虑,想必你也看出来了……

English: You see, I have found myself presented with quite the ((dilemma)). It's really ((nothing)) to worry about, so please don't cause a fuss! I have the whole thing ((quite)) under control.
Chinese: 要知道,我正面临一个相当((棘手))的困局。真的((没什么))可担心的,所以请别大惊小怪!整件事我((尽在掌握))。

English: I was merely indulging in a scryshroom meditation to divine what manner of threat this [[giant monster]] could pose. And, uh, it turns out it's really not much of a problem at all. <<She gulps.>>
Chinese: 我只是在用窥菇冥想,占算这只[[巨型怪物]]可能构成何种威胁。呃,结果发现它其实根本不算什么大问题。<<她咽了口唾沫。>>

English: Wait, what's this about a ((giant monster))?
Chinese: 等等,((巨型怪物))是怎么回事?

English: Oh, so it's not common knowledge? <<She looks genuinely relieved.>>##I thought the whole town would be talking about it by now...
Chinese: 哦,这事还没人尽皆知?<<她如释重负。>> ##我还以为全镇早就在议论了……

English: How ((reliable)) are these divinations?
Chinese: 这些占卜((有多可靠))?

English: Oh, in Pwyll we pride ourselves on our scryshroom divinations ((always)) being reliable. Except, uh, for when they're not. ##Sometimes the drug can exacerbate the user's hopes and fears, making the vision more... ((fantastical)) than prophetic.
Chinese: 哦,在普威尔,我们以窥菇占卜((向来))可靠而自豪。呃,除了不灵的时候。 ##有时药物会放大使用者的希望与恐惧,让幻象更像……((幻想)),而非预言。

English: Well, you seem like you have the situation firmly under control.
Chinese: 嗯,看来局势已被你牢牢掌控。

English: Wait! ##<<She screams the word, then laughs nervously.>> I mean, when I say it's not ((much)) of a problem, I was perhaps, ah, honey-coating the situation a little...
Chinese: 等等! ##<<她尖叫出这个词,又紧张地笑起来。>>我是说,当我说它((算不上))什么大问题时,我或许,呃,给情况涂了点糖衣……

English: You see, a small mercenary band has made certain, um, demands. No, I don't mean Vela's Dark Stars - this lot are much less, uh, ((accomplished)) - which makes it all the more puzzling how they've got their hands on a [[giant nautilob]].
Chinese: 要知道,一支小佣兵团提出了些,呃,要求。不,我不是指薇拉的黑星佣兵团——这伙人远没那么((有本事))——这就更让人费解了,他们是怎么弄到一只[[巨型鹦鹉螺妖]]的。

English: What's a nautilob, exactly?
Chinese: 鹦鹉螺妖到底是什么?

English: <<She waves her hand dismissively.>> Just a Skyrealms mollusc that you find around these parts - easily recognisable by their shells. But, I had absolutely no idea they could get this ((big))!
Chinese: <<她不以为意地摆摆手。>>不过是这片天空领域常见的一种软体动物,凭贝壳一眼就能认出。可我完全没想到它们能长这么((大))!

English: So what - you want ((my)) help?
Chinese: 所以呢——你想((我))帮忙?

English: Oh ((no))! I never said anything like that - as mayor of this place, I have everything completely under control. ##<<She narrows her eyes.>> Of course, that being said...
Chinese: 哦((不))!我从没说过那种话——作为本地的镇长,一切都完全在我掌控之中。 ##<<她眯起眼睛。>>当然,话虽如此……

English: Those mercenary scoundrels are threatening me with their huge nautilob. They claim they'll sack the town if I don't comply with their absurd demands. I ((really)) don't want to cause a panic in the town, so I'm at a loss at what to do.
Chinese: 那些佣兵恶棍用他们的大鹦鹉螺妖威胁我。声称若我不答应他们的荒唐要求,就洗劫全镇。我((实在))不想在镇里引起恐慌,所以一时不知所措。

English: But, If ((someone)) could sneak into their fortress to the [[south-east]], and ascertain whether this [[nautilob]] thing has any [[weakness]] we could exploit... well, let's just say that person would find themselves firmly within my favour.
Chinese: 不过,要是((有人))能溜进他们[[东南边]]的堡垒,查清这只[[鹦鹉螺妖]]有没有可利用的[[弱点]]……这么说吧,那个人会稳稳得到我的青睐。

English: I'll see what I can do.
Chinese: 我尽力而为。

English: <<She gives you a sly smile.>> Very well. ##Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: <<她冲你狡黠一笑。>>很好。 ##那么,还有别的事吗?

English: What if those mercenaries were to ((disappear?))
Chinese: 要是那些佣兵((消失))了呢?

English: Oh! Well that would be quite the tragedy. The idea of more blood being spilled on Pwyllian soil is a ((horrible)) thought.
Chinese: 哦!那可真是悲剧。让更多血洒在普威尔的土地上,这念头((可怕))极了。

English: <<Her eyes narrow.>> But of course, it ((would)) rather solve the problem here, wouldn't it? And with so little funds to hire guards, it would be ((awfully)) hard to catch the perpetrator of such a crime...
Chinese: <<她眯起眼睛。>>不过当然,那((确实))能把眼前的问题解决得相当干净,不是吗?何况雇卫兵的经费少得可怜,要抓到这种罪行的元凶((想必))难如登天……

English: <<She smiles suddenly.>> Oh, but pay me no mind! I'm merely thinking out loud. Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: <<她突然一笑。>>哦,别把我放在心上!我不过是自言自语。那么,还有别的事吗?

English: I'll have nothing to do with this.
Chinese: 这事我可不沾。

English: <<She winks.>> Oh, of ((course)) you wouldn't. - I'd never dream of it! ##Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: <<她眨眨眼。>>哦,你((当然))不会沾。- 我做梦都不会这么想! ##那么,还有别的事吗?

English: Ah, you're back. <<She sighs.>> I suppose I have a few moments to talk.
Chinese: 啊,你回来了。<<她叹了口气。>>我想我还有点时间可以聊聊。

English: The mercenaries say you never paid them.
Chinese: 佣兵们说你从没付过钱。

English: Well, I never paid them the full amount, no. But that's because they made a ((ghastly)) mess of the whole thing!
Chinese: 呃,我确实没付全款。但那是因为他们把整件事搞得((一塌糊涂))!

English: I hired them to clear out a few nautilobs from the surrounding forest. They managed to kill a measly ((three)), and then had to retreat because one of their men tripped and fell on his own spear. I mean, what kind of idiots ((are)) they?
Chinese: 我雇他们清剿周围森林里的几只鹦鹉螺妖。他们好歹才杀了区区((三只)),然后就得撤退,因为他们有个家伙绊了一跤,摔在自己的矛上。你说说,他们到底是((什么样))的蠢货?

English: You won't have to worry about that giant nautilob anymore.
Chinese: 那只巨型鹦鹉螺妖你再也不用担心了。

English: Oh, really? Why, this is ((splendid)) news! Please, tell me the details...
Chinese: 哦,真的?哎呀,这可是((大好))消息!快,跟我说说细节……

English: Well, I killed their leader. I doubt they'll be troubling you any more.
Chinese: 呃,我把他们头目杀了。想必他们不会再烦你了。

English: Ah. Oh. Oh dear.
Chinese: 啊。哦。哎呀。

English: I mean, it's good that the problem has been resolved. Very good indeed. But just to be perfectly clear - I never ((asked)) you to kill anyone, correct?
Chinese: 我是说,问题解决了总是好的。再好不过了。不过把话说清楚——我从没((要求))你杀任何人,对吧?

English: Actually, you strongly hinted that I could.
Chinese: 其实,你强烈暗示我可以这么做。

English: Ahah. Hah. Well, that's ((your interpretation)) dear. Let's leave it at that, shall we?
Chinese: 啊哈。哈。嗯,那是((你的解读)),亲爱的。就到此为止吧,好不好?

English: Well you didn't say I ((couldn't)).
Chinese: 可你没说我不((能))。

English: That's an interesting interpretation of my request. Let's just speak no more of the matter, shall we?
Chinese: 你对我的要求倒有个有趣的解读。这事儿咱们就别再提了,好吗?

English: Oh and, another thing - that giant nautilob? It was an illusion.
Chinese: 哦,还有件事——那只巨型鹦鹉螺妖?是幻象。

English: <<A maniac smile spreads across her lips.>> Oh! That's just wonderful. We've butchered a bunch of mercenaries and it turns out they're ((innocent)).
Chinese: <<一抹狂笑在她嘴角蔓延。>>哦!真是太好了。我们屠了一伙佣兵,结果人家((无辜))。

English: I'll tell you what- I'm going to give you this [[reward]]. A truly well-earned reward for a job thoroughly well done. And as ((part)) of this reward, yes, we're going to never speak about this ((ever)) again, correct?
Chinese: 这样吧——我把这份[[赏金]]给你。活干得漂亮,受之无愧的赏金。而这份赏金的((一部分))是:对,这件事我们((永远))不再提起,对吧?

English: <<A deadly serious expression engulfs her face.>> Not. To. ((Anyone)).
Chinese: <<她脸上骤然凝起极度的严肃。>>不。许。对((任何人))讲。

English: <<She breaks into a jolly smile.>> Well, that's settled then, yes?
Chinese: <<她绽出愉快的笑容。>>好,那就这么定了,好吗?

English: The nautilob was an illusion, nothing more.
Chinese: 鹦鹉螺妖只是幻象,仅此而已。

English: Oh! Oh my! ((Really?))
Chinese: 哦!天哪!((真的?))

English: ...I can't believe I didn't think of that! So the town is saved? We're not going to burn alive? Hurrah!
Chinese: ……我竟然没想到这个!所以全镇得救了?我们不会被活活烧死了?万岁!

English: Anyway, please take this [[reward]] along with my heartfelt thanks. You've done Pwyll a fine service today.
Chinese: 总之,请收下这份[[赏金]],连同我由衷的谢意。你今天为普威尔立了大功。

English: About this giant nautilob...
Chinese: 关于那只巨型鹦鹉螺妖……

English: Oh, yes... I'm presuming it's still ((there?))
Chinese: 哦,对……我猜它还在((那儿?))

English: I'm looking for Dark Star mercenaries.
Chinese: 我在找黑星佣兵。

English: Oh ((please.)) If I hear one more word about those bloody ((Dark Stars...)) <<She shakes her head.>>
Chinese: 哦((拜托。))那些该死的((黑星佣兵团))我再一个字都不想听……<<她摇摇头。>>

English: We've always had our fair share of miscreants attracted to Pwyll - It turns out it's not only ((poets and horticulturalists)) who are attracted to the solitude of the countryside...
Chinese: 被普威尔吸引来的无赖,我们向来不少——原来迷恋乡野孤寂的((不只是诗人和园艺师))……

English: But when that wretched ((Vela Callose)) moved in with her cohorts, you wouldn't ((believe)) the type of scoundrels we had prancing up and down our idyllic cobbled streets. ##<<She sighs.>> And now, on top of everything else, we have the ((Inquisition)) raiding the island!
Chinese: 可当那个可恶的((薇拉·卡洛斯))带着她的同伙入驻后,在我们田园诗般的鹅卵石街上窜来窜去的无赖,你根本((想象不到))是些什么货色。 ##<<她叹了口气。>>而现在,更糟的是,((宗教裁判所))又在突袭本岛!

English: So I'm sorry, but if you have dealings with those ruffians, I really can't help you. Maybe you'll have better luck with someone else around town.
Chinese: 所以抱歉,你要是跟那帮恶棍有来往,我可帮不上忙。镇上换别人问也许运气更好。

English: Do you know about any ((Wikkan worship)) going on?
Chinese: 你知道这儿有((维坎崇拜))的动静吗?

English: God-worship? In ((Pwyll))? Surely not. Most of the villagers who are old enough to remember actively ((relishing)) the death of their former god Aenguin, for all the horrible things he did.
Chinese: 拜神?在((普威尔))?绝不会。凡是年纪够大、记得往事的村民,无不((庆幸))旧神安圭因的死——他干的坏事可太多了。

English: I met your son, Lludd.
Chinese: 我见过你儿子卢德。

English: Oh! Yes, my ((darling)) boy. Was he just loitering around on the path again? I can never get that boy to pursue his ((studies)), no matter how hard I try...
Chinese: 哦!对,我那((宝贝))儿子。他又在路上闲晃了?不管我多用心,那孩子就是不肯用功((读书))……

English: <<She sighs.>> But, I shouldn't be too hard on him. There aren't any other children his age in Pwyll, and my mayoral duties keep me ((so)) busy...  ##((Oh, that reminds me - it's nearly time for my invigorating intonations...))
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>不过,我也不该对他太严厉。普威尔没有别的同龄孩子,镇长职务又让我((实在))忙碌…… ##((哦,对了——快到我提神咏唱的时辰了……))

English: About your son...
Chinese: 关于你儿子……

English: Oh, so ((you're)) the vigilant stranger who saved my son? I really ((cannot)) thank you enough - I don't know what I would have done, had he...
Chinese: 哦,原来((你))就是救了我儿子那位警觉的陌生人?我真((不知))怎么感谢你才好——要是他当时……我简直不敢想……

English: <<She sniffs, tears in her eyes.>> I know I can be ((distracted)) sometimes, but it's only because I want Pwyll to be a perfect ((home)) for Lludd. I suppose I took it too far, considering what he tried to ((do))...
Chinese: <<她抽了抽鼻子,眼含热泪。>>我知道自己有时((心不在焉)),但那只是因为我想让普威尔成为卢德完美的((家)). 想到他试图((做))的事,我想我是把劲使过头了……

English: Please, I want you to have the most valuable thing I possess...
Chinese: 求你,把我拥有的最珍贵之物送给你……

English: ...these [[healing herbs]], from my garden. There really is nothing more precious than ((nature's bounty)),
Chinese: ……这些[[疗伤草药]],来自我的花园。世上确实没有什么比((大自然的馈赠))更珍贵了。

English: Oh, so you heard about his... passing? <<She sniffs, tears in her eyes.>>
Chinese: 哦,你听说他的……死讯了?<<她抽了抽鼻子,眼含热泪。>>

English: I just never expected he would ((do)) such a thing. Everything I've done here in Pwyll was for ((him)). To lose him like this, it's just so...
Chinese: 我从没想过他会((做))这种事。我在普威尔所做的一切都是为了((他)). 这样失去他,实在是……

English: <<She wipes away tears.>> I'm sorry, but I need a moment... to myself...
Chinese: <<她拭去泪水。>>抱歉,我需要独自……静一静……

English: I had questions about this town.
Chinese: 关于这个镇子我有几个问题。

English: <<She sighs.>> As Pwyll's mayor I am of course ((exhaustively)) busy, but... <<She mumbles to herself.>> ...((I suppose I can postpone my meditative dance until later.))
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>身为普威尔镇长,我自然((忙得不可开交))。但……<<她喃喃自语。>>……((我想我可以把冥想之舞推迟一下。))

English: What's the story of this place?
Chinese: 这地方有什么来历?

English: Well, before the [[God War]], Pwyll worshipped a deity named Aenguin. I must admit, this was all rather before my time - but I've heard it said that he was particularly ((cruel)) - probably why the villagers committed deicide by impaling the bugger with a voidspear.
Chinese: 嗯,[[神之战]]之前,普威尔崇拜一位名叫安圭因的神明。我得承认,这些都远在我出生之前——但听人说,他特别((残暴)),恐怕正因如此,村民们才犯下弑神之举,用虚空长矛把那家伙钉了个透心凉。

English: After the war, the nearby fortress fell into ruin and proved the perfect staging ground for brigands and mercenaries. Pwyll got caught up in a whole load of ((illicit)) business, culminating in the previous mayor getting imprisoned on extortion charges...
Chinese: 战后,附近的堡垒沦为废墟,倒成了土匪和佣兵理想的落脚点。普威尔卷入了一大堆((非法))勾当,最后前任镇长还因勒索罪锒铛入狱……

English: You see, he pilfered a Wikkan artefact and grew six limbs, just as the inquisition were really cracking down on ((extortion)).
Chinese: 要知道,他偷了一件维坎教团的圣物,长出了六条肢体,偏偏赶上宗教裁判所正大力整治((勒索))案。

English: And that's when ((I)) happened to be passing through. The villagers of Pwyll had decided that a new mayor would be decided by a contest of horticulture. I cultivated a small garden of hymnal hydrangeas that could sing in three octaves, and ((that)) was ((that)).
Chinese: 而那时恰巧((我))路过此地。普威尔村民决定以园艺比赛选出新镇长。我培育出一小园能以三个八度歌唱的圣咏绣球花,((事情))就这么((定了))。

English: Oh, Pwyll has a long and compelling history. Did you know that in all of the Apostatic Union, we have won ((by far)) the most agricultural competitions for the ((quality)) of our produce? Or that, though small, our scryshroom farms can rival the orchards of Byonne in yield?
Chinese: 哦,普威尔的历史悠久又引人入胜。你可知道,整个叛教联盟,凭农产品的((品质)),我们赢下的农业竞赛奖项((遥遥))领先?还有,别看地方小,我们窥菇农场的产量足以媲美拜昂的果园呢?

English: <<She waves a hand.>> Oh, and there's also the drama of Pwyll's [[terrible god]] who was killed by his own worshippers - but it's all rather before my time, so you'd have to ask [[weighmaster Culwych]] about that I'm afraid.
Chinese: <<她挥了挥手。>>哦,还有普威尔那位[[可怕的神]]被自己的信徒杀死的大戏——不过这都远在我出生之前了,恐怕你得去问[[秤量官卡尔威奇]]。

English: You see, I became mayor of this place somewhat by ((accident.)) I was passing through just as the villagers were electing a new mayor - for the last one had been suddenly - if not ((unexpectedly)) - imprisoned on extortion charges.
Chinese: 要知道,我当上这地方的镇长多少出于((偶然。))当时我正好路过,村民正在选新镇长——因为前任突然——虽说算不上((出乎意料))——因勒索罪锒铛入狱。

English: The mayoral contest was one of horticulture. I cultivated a small garden of hymnal hydrangeas that could sing in three octaves, and ((that)) was ((that)).
Chinese: 镇长之争是一场园艺赛。我培育出一小园能以三个八度歌唱的圣咏绣球花,((事情))就这么((定了))。

English: So wait, you're not actually ((from)) Pwyll?
Chinese: 等等,你其实((不是))普威尔本地人?

English: Oh, not in the least. I'm from a really rather important family in Lundel, and was only travelling around the Oneiric Isles to escape the frightfully ((dreary)) star cycles we have there.
Chinese: 哦,完全不是。我来自伦德尔一个相当显赫的家族,周游梦幻群岛只是为了躲开我们那儿无聊得吓人的((星辰周期))。

English: I can't say it's traditional for a village such as Pwyll to elect an outsider, but I think they've taken to the idea rather well. Only occasionally do I get a nautilob thrown through my window or a laxative spell nailed to my door.
Chinese: 我不能说让普威尔这样的村子选个外乡人合乎传统,但我觉得他们已经相当适应这个主意了。只是偶尔会有鹦鹉螺妖砸穿我家窗户,或是通便咒被钉在我门上。

English: Okay, I get the picture.
Chinese: 好了,我明白了。

English: Was there anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗?

English: You seem quite smitten with this hallucinogenic tea.
Chinese: 你似乎对这种迷幻茶情有独钟。

English: <<She scrunches her nose.>> Pwyll's scryshroom is not merely ((hallucinogenic)); it submerges one's consciousness into the temporal current. In other words, it allows you to ((see the future)).
Chinese: <<她皱起鼻子。>>普威尔的窥菇可不只是((迷幻药));它能把人的意识浸入时间之流。换句话说,它能让你((预见未来))。

English: If that's true, why isn't everyone drinking it?
Chinese: 若真如此,怎么不是人人都在喝?

English: Well, our soil is arid and our harvests are poor, so we can't meet demand! There's also the matter of, ((ahem)), its variable efficacy...
Chinese: 唉,我们土地贫瘠,收成又差,根本供不应求!还有个问题,((咳咳)),就是它的药效不太稳定……

English: Sounds potent.
Chinese: 听起来药性很猛。

English: Oh, it's ((extremely)) potent! The visions are of such intensity that one can be forgiven for thinking they are ((really)) occurring. Though... it's important to interpret such visions with a pinch of caution.
Chinese: 哦,((极其))猛烈!那些幻象强烈得让人不禁以为它们((真的))正在发生。不过……解读这类幻象时还是得留几分谨慎。

English: You see, not ((everything)) the scryshrooms predict will come to pass. The cosmos is a web of infinite possibilities, and the future is not struck in stone. The users' hopes and fears can also ((taint)) the vision in, uh, ((rare)) cases.
Chinese: 要知道,窥菇所预言的((一切))并非都会成真。宇宙是一张无限可能之网,未来并未刻在石头上。在某些,呃,((罕见))情况下,使用者的希望与恐惧也会((污染))幻象。

English: They're also known to cause... <<She clears her throat, then quickly mumbles the words.>> ...((fainting, nausea, delusions of grandeur, extreme anxiety, abnormally bushy eyebrows, independently sentient limbs, and death)).
Chinese: 据说它们还会导致……<<她清了清嗓子,然后飞快地咕哝道。>>……((昏厥、恶心、妄自尊大、极度焦虑、眉毛异常浓密、肢体自主成精,以及死亡))。

English: But all the more reason why we must use the scryshroom ((responsibly)), yes? And they really ((are)) quite good for digestion.
Chinese: 但这也更说明我们必须((负责任地))使用窥菇,对吧?况且它们((确实))相当助消化。

English: Did you know there was a mercenary band in that old fort?
Chinese: 你可知道那座旧堡垒里驻着一支佣兵团?

English: Well, I wouldn't be much of a mayor if I ((didn't)) know that, would I? Under Union law, mercenaries are perfectly legal organisations. The trouble is that in peacetime they tend to lean towards more... ((illicit)) pursuits.
Chinese: 我要是((连这))都不知道,还当什么镇长,对吧?依照联盟法律,佣兵团是完全合法的组织。麻烦在于,和平年代他们总爱转向更……((非法))的营生。

English: Being so far from the capital city of Riova, Pwyll's attracted numerous types of ruffians over the years. They never caused ((too)) much trouble; at least until Vela's [[Dark Star]] mercenaries moved in. You'd never have guessed they were once the most respected sellswords in the Union, based on their recent behaviour!
Chinese: 由于远离国都里奥瓦,这些年来普威尔招来了形形色色的无赖。他们倒也没惹过((太大))麻烦;至少在薇拉的[[黑星佣兵团]]入驻之前是如此。看看他们最近的行径,你绝想不到他们曾是联盟最受敬重的雇佣剑士!

English: I'm sure you've noticed all that ruckus coming from the old God War fortress? The Apostatic Union has finally had enough, you see. It's about time they taught that ((Vela)) a lesson, but all those explosions are really disrupting my morning routine.
Chinese: 相信你注意到那座神战旧堡垒传来的喧闹了吧?叛教联盟终于忍无可忍了,你瞧。是时候给那个((薇拉))一点教训了,可那些爆炸声实在搅扰了我晨间的惯例。

English: Do you think any Dark Stars could be hiding in Pwyll?
Chinese: 你觉得会有黑星佣兵藏在普威尔吗?

English: Well, we're quite used to the odd group of Dark Stars stumbling into the town for a drink or ten. But beyond that, I really wouldn't have the slightest clue.
Chinese: 嗯,偶尔有几伙黑星佣兵晃进镇子喝上十来杯,我们早已司空见惯。但除此之外,我实在一无所知。

English: I know [[Nudd]] has done some jobs for them. You can usually find him in the [[local shop]] - why don't you try bothering - uh, ((asking)) him about it?
Chinese: 我知道[[纳德]]替他们干过些活。通常你能在[[本地商店]]找到他——你不如去打扰——呃,((问问))他?

English: Thanks for the info.
Chinese: 多谢告知。

English: <<She sighs.>> Was there anything else?
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>还有别的事吗?

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Goodbye. You can see yourself out, yes?
Chinese: 再见。你自己能找到出去的路,对吧?

English: I found Wikkan antiques in your basement. The ((illegal)) kind.
Chinese: 我在你地下室发现了维坎古董。((非法))的那种。

English: <<She frowns.>> First of all, what the fuck have you been doing in my basement? I've allowed you into my house as a ((guest)), not for you to go digging through my possessions!
Chinese: <<她皱起眉头。>>首先,你他妈在我地下室干什么呢?我准你进我家是把你当((客人)),不是让你来翻我的东西!

English: And as for those ((antiques)), they were simply left here by the previous mayor. I have absolutely ((nothing)) to do with them!
Chinese: 至于那些((古董)),不过是前任镇长留下的。我跟它们((毫无))干系!

English: Now if you'll excuse me, I think you should make yourself scarce.
Chinese: 恕我失陪,我觉得你最好识相点,赶紧消失。

English: Ah! Welcome, welcome; pull up a stool. If yer lookin' for scryshroom, you've come to the right place. ##<<He leans on the counter and thrusts a bulging eye in your direction.>> D'ya know what scryshroom ((does)), newcomer?
Chinese: 啊!欢迎欢迎,拉把凳子坐。要是找窥菇,你可来对地方了。##<<他倚在柜台上,朝你瞪起一只凸出的眼睛。>>知道窥菇((是干嘛的))吗,新来的?

English: Yes.
Chinese: 知道。

English: Then you'll have 'eard it shows you the ((future)). But, see, that puts some folk ((off)), as they're scared of what they might see. I'm here to tell 'ya it ain't ((like)) that.
Chinese: 那你该听说过它能让你看见((未来))。可你瞧,这就把一些人((吓退))了,他们怕看见不该看的。我来告诉你,根本((不是))那么回事。

English: No.
Chinese: 不知道。

English: Well, where've you been stuffin' your noggin? Scryshroom shows you your ((future)), in all its brilliant glory!
Chinese: 嘿,那你脑袋平日都塞的什么?窥菇能让你看见自己的((未来)),辉煌壮丽,一览无余!

English: There ain't no cipher spell in the Great Library of Byonne that can do what scryshroom does. It plunges y'er into the ((river)) of ((time)), so you can see the bends an' the currents rushin' towards ya.
Chinese: 拜昂大图书馆里没有任何密文法术能做到窥菇的本事。它把你浸入((时间))的((长河)),让你看清前方的河湾与扑面而来的激流。

English: D'ya know how I grew this business? Not with ((luck)), my friend - oh ((no)). I used the 'umble scryshroom to ((outsmart)) my rivals, and now my company ships 'em to every corner o' the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 知道我这生意是怎么做大的吗?靠的可((不是))运气,我的朋友——哦((绝不))是。我用这不起眼的窥菇((算计))得对手团团转,如今我的商行把它们卖到叛教联盟的每个角落。

English: So whad'ya say - you buyin'?
Chinese: 所以怎么样——买不买?

English: So wait - do these visions always come ((true))?
Chinese: 等等——这些幻象都会((应验))吗?

English: <<He squirms a little.>> Well now, I can't say they're ((always)) right. The future can be ((changed)), see? An' I won't be held accountable for any foolishness or failures you get yerself into after you use 'em.
Chinese: <<他有点局促不安。>>这个嘛,我可不敢说它们((回回))都准。未来是能((改变))的,明白吗?你用了之后自己犯傻倒霉,我可一概不负责。

English: Okay, you've convinced me - what're you selling?
Chinese: 行,你说动我了——你卖什么?

English: Actually, I wanted to ask you some questions...
Chinese: 其实,我想问你几个问题……

English: <<He frowns, disappointed.>> Hmph, alright. Whad'ya want to know?
Chinese: <<他失望地皱起眉头。>>哼,行吧。你想知道什么?

English: Always good to see a returnin' customer. What can I do for ya? We got [[scryshroom tea]] brewin', an' I've a [[room to rent]] upstairs.
Chinese: 老顾客上门总是高兴。能为你做点什么?我们有[[窥菇茶]]正煮着,楼上还有[[房间出租]]。

English: Have you heard the rumours of ((god-worshippers)) in Pwyll?
Chinese: 你听说过普威尔有((拜神者))的传闻吗?

English: <<He frowns.>> Now look, that's a pretty nasty accusation to be throwin' around willy nilly. What ((exactly)) are yer gettin' at, ((newcomer))?
Chinese: <<他皱起眉头。>>喂,听着,这种恶毒的指控可不能满嘴乱放。你((究竟))想说什么,((新来的))?

English: Of all the people in Pwyll, ((you)) stand the most to gain from a better harvest, no?
Chinese: 普威尔上下,收成好转时((你))获益最大,不是吗?

English: You ((dare)) accuse me of such a thing in my ((own)) shop? Now listen 'ere you runt; I 'ad family who sacrificed themselves to that cunt of a god, just so we could be 'ere today.
Chinese: 你((竟敢))在我((自家))店里指控我这种事?给你这小子听好了;我有家人为向那狗娘养的破神献祭送了命,才换来我们今天还在这里。

English: I remember bein' just a boy, and seein' my uncle - who raised me like I was his ((own)) - walk into the Sacred Shroom, never to come back. If I knew of ((anyone)) who was cavortin' with Wikkans, I'd... ((I'd...))
Chinese: 我记得自己还是个孩子的时候,眼看着我叔叔——他把我当((亲生))骨肉养大——走进神圣蘑菇,再也没回来。要是让我知道((有谁))跟维坎教团勾勾搭搭,我会……((我会……))

English: I'm not accusing anyone; just asking a harmless question...
Chinese: 我没指控谁;只是问个无伤大雅的问题……

English: Damn ((right)) y'er not accusin' anyone. 'Cos I'm old enough to have lost family to that bastard god, like plenty other folk round 'ere. The thought o' bringing him back sends a chill through my bones.
Chinese: 你最好((没))指控谁。我这把年纪,像这儿不少人一样,都有亲人丧命于那杂种神之手。一想到要让他复活,我就寒透骨髓。

English: <<He sighs heavily.>> It's true the business 'as been ((hurtin')) lately. The soil's not what it was when I was a boy, an' each year the yield gets leaner...
Chinese: <<他重重叹了口气。>>生意近来((不景气))倒是真的。土壤不复我小时候那般肥沃,收成一年比一年薄……

English: But I'd sooner pack the whole thing in, an' be beggin' on the streets of Hallowshire, than subject Pwyll to that tyrant god again.
Chinese: 但我宁可把这摊子整个关掉,去哈洛郡的街头要饭,也不愿再让普威尔屈服于那个暴君神。

English: <<He lowers his voice to a hushed whisper.>> If there really (('are)) folk around 'ere praying to Aenguin - an' I'm not saying there ((are)) - they'd be doin' it under the [[cover of darkness]], I'd wager.
Chinese: <<他压低声音,悄声耳语。>>要是这附近真((有))人向安圭因祈祷——我可没说((有))——我敢打赌,他们会趁着[[夜色掩护]]行事。

English: Only last night I saw someone [[lurkin' in the dark]] as I was packin' up. Now, if someone were to [[rest until nightfall]], they might be able to get a better look...
Chinese: 就在昨晚,我收摊的时候看见有人在[[暗处鬼鬼祟祟]]。嗯,要是有人肯[[休息到夜幕降临]],兴许能把那看个仔细……

English: But that'll be all I'll say on the matter. So don't be askin' me again, y'hear?
Chinese: 这事儿我就说到这儿。别再问我了,听见没?

English: Did you know there are mercenaries with a ((monster)) outside town?
Chinese: 你可知道镇外有佣兵带着一头((怪物))?

English: <<He grumbles some curses under his breath.>> I 'eard as much from one o' our regular merchants. He said summin' about a beast floatin' over the ol' fort...
Chinese: <<他低声咒骂了几句。>>我们的老主顾商人跟我说过一嘴。他说有什么畜生飘在旧堡垒上空……

English: It's those Rotten Onion lads again, 'aint it? Always trialin' some hairbrained scheme - all the while scarin' off my tradin' partners!
Chinese: 又是那帮烂洋葱小子,是不是?净折腾些脑残计划——还把我生意伙伴全吓跑了!

English: I'd like to peruse your services.
Chinese: 我想看看你这儿的服务。

English: That's what I like to 'ear. I've got a pot of [[scryshroom tea]] on the brew, an' we've also got a few other odds an' ends if y'er hankerin' for supplies. ##I've also a [[room to rent]] upstairs, for two coin, if you need some rest.
Chinese: 这就爱听。我有一壶[[窥菇茶]]正煮着,要是你想补给点杂物,我们这儿也有几样小玩意。##楼上还有[[房间出租]],两个硬币,你要歇脚的话。

English: Let's see what you have for sale.
Chinese: 让我看看你卖什么。

English: Alright, 'ere's what we got...
Chinese: 好嘞,瞧瞧这些货……

English: I want to rent the room.
Chinese: 我要租那间房。

English: Thankin' ye. It's just up the stairs there. ##I'll try an' keep the ruckus down in the morning, when we're packin' up the goods.
Chinese: 多谢。就在那边楼梯上去。##早上装货的时候,我会尽量压着点动静。

English: Aye, It's yours for two coins.
Chinese: 好嘞,两个硬币,归你了。

English: Looks like you don't have the coin, there. Come back when y'eve scraped some together.
Chinese: 看来你钱不够啊。攒够了再来。

English: Actually, never mind.
Chinese: 其实,算了。

English: Changed yer mind, eh? Well will there be anythin' else?
Chinese: 改主意了,嗯?那还有别的事吗?

English: I have some questions for you.
Chinese: 我有几个问题想请教你。

English: Well, if you wanna know about scryshrooms, I'm the person to ask. Been growin' an' tradin' 'em since I was ((this)) high.
Chinese: 呃,想了解窥菇,问我就对了。打从我((这么))高的时候,我就种菇卖菇了。

English: How's the scrysrhoom trade?
Chinese: 窥菇生意怎么样?

English: Oh, demand's never been better. This shop I run's just outta respect for the village; but really, I make my money sellin' shrooms in bulk to merchants. And there's a real penchant for the stuff.
Chinese: 哦,需求空前的好。我开这家店纯粹是给村里面子;实际上,我的钱都是大批卖给商人挣的。这玩意儿可是紧俏货。

English: These days, peddlers, poets and polymaths alike are drinkin' the stuff from Lundel to Vena. In the tearooms of Byonne, ladies an' gents are seein' their futures unfurl before 'em...
Chinese: 如今,从伦德尔到维纳,小贩、诗人、博学家都喝上了这玩意。拜昂的茶室里,淑女绅士们看着自己的未来在眼前展开……

English: But, I'd be lyin' if I said it was ((all)) good news. The harvest's been down lately, an' each year we're growin' less of the stuff. ##<<He speaks low, suddenly sullen.>> If uncle were here, he'd know what to do...
Chinese: 不过,要我说这((全是))好消息,那就是撒谎了。近来收成一直下滑,每年种的菇越来越少。##<<他声音低沉下来,忽然闷闷不乐。>>叔叔要是在,他知道该怎么办……

English: Y'know, it's the strangest thing. The scryshroom fields 'ave suddenly started sproutin' like never before! I think Pwyll's luck might be changin'...
Chinese: 你知道吗,真是怪事一桩。窥菇田突然疯长起来,前所未见!我看普威尔的运气要转了……

English: I heard Pwyll had a certain reputation for ((smuggling))...
Chinese: 我听说普威尔在((走私))方面颇有点名声……

English: <<He shoots you an angry glance.>> Lotta folk talk about that. Lotta folk don't know what they're ((talkin')) about.
Chinese: <<他恼火地瞪了你一眼。>>很多人爱嚼这舌头。很多人根本不知道自己在((胡扯))什么。

English: Sure, a lot of mercenaries 'ave set up shop around these parts. And yeah, we trade with 'em. But here in Pwyll we pay our taxes jus' like ((anyone)) in the Union. That's why ol' Culwych went to Riova to learn t'be a weighmaster, an' all.
Chinese: 没错,很多佣兵在这一带扎了营。是,我们跟他们做买卖。但在普威尔,我们跟联盟里((任何))人一样照章纳税。老卡尔威奇还专门去里奥瓦学当秤量官呢,就是这么回事。

English: <<His eyes narrow.>> An' if you've been snoopin' around and seen some things you don't like the look of, I'd advise you to ((keep yer trap shut)). I don't pay Nudd over there just for his looks, y'know? He ((protects)) my business interests. Hear me?
Chinese: <<他眯起眼睛。>>要是你到处窥探,看见什么不顺眼的东西,我劝你((把嘴闭紧))。我付钱给那边的纳德,可不只是看他长得俊,知道吗?他((护着))我的生意。听明白了吗?

English: Is there anywhere I can buy an Apostatic Union Passport?
Chinese: 哪里能买到叛教联盟护照?

English: Only union officials an' certified traders can dispense 'em. You'll be wantin' to talk to our [[local weighmaster, Culwych]], over at the weigh house - but he won't just hand 'em out for anyone.
Chinese: 只有联盟官员和认证商人才能发护照。你得去找我们的[[本地秤量官卡尔威奇]],就在称量所——但他可不会随便见人就发。

English: You look like a resourceful merchant. I have ((coin)), and I'm willing to pay...
Chinese: 你看着就是个门路多的商人。我有((硬币)),也愿意出钱……

English: <<He narrows his eyes.>> Careful, now. Yer suggestin' an ((illegal)) trade. That sorta talk could see us ((both)) rottin' in an inquisition cell...
Chinese: <<他眯起眼睛。>>小心点。你这是在提议((非法))交易。这种话说出去,((咱俩))都得烂在宗教裁判所的牢房里……

English: @@Don't worry, you can trust me.
Chinese: @@别担心,你可以信我。

English: %%<<He is silent a moment, staring into your eyes.>> ##...Alright. But a hint of this to anyone, an' Nudd over there will be addin' some new ((kneecaps)) to his collection.
Chinese: %%<<他沉默片刻,直盯着你的眼睛。>> ##……好吧。但这事你敢跟任何人露一丝口风,那边的纳德就会往他的收藏里添几副新的((膝盖骨))。

English: Go to the windmill; there's a locked door leadin' to the basement. [[This key]] will get you in, an' you'll find my [[business associate]] down there. She'll sort you out...
Chinese: 去风车磨坊;有扇上锁的门通向地下室。[[这把钥匙]]能开门,我的[[生意伙伴]]就在下面。她会替你打点好……

English: Now, get outta my sight. We never (('ad)) this conversation, y'hear?
Chinese: 现在,从我眼前消失。今天这番对话((根本))没发生过,听见没?

English: &&((Squidshit)). I 'aint trustin just anyone who walks through my doors.
Chinese: &&((鱿鱼屎))。凡是从我店门进来的,我可谁都不轻信。

English: Okay, never mind.
Chinese: 好吧,当我没说。

English: Okay, thanks.
Chinese: 好,谢谢。

English: <<He nods.>> Anythin' else?
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>还有事吗?

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: <<He nods.>> Come again now.
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>常来啊。

English: <<The man sips his tea and studies you intently.>> New face, eh? If you've got business here, talk to Dwynn at the counter. He's the proprietor of this business; I'm really only employed to make sure things go ((smoothly)).
Chinese: <<那人啜了口茶,仔细打量你。>>生面孔,嗯?有生意上的事,找柜台的德温。他是这买卖的东家;我受雇只是确保一切((顺利))运转。

English: You don't seem like the rest of the villagers.
Chinese: 你看起来跟其他村民不太一样。

English: <<He betrays a thin smile.>> My, you're ((perceptive)), eh?
Chinese: <<他掠过一丝浅笑。>>哎呀,你真((敏锐)),是吧?

English: And how do you make sure things go smoothly, exactly?
Chinese: 那你到底是怎样确保一切顺利的呢?

English: Well, the details are of such a nature that I wouldn't feel comfortable discussing them... <<he takes a sip,>> over ((tea)).
Chinese: 嗯,那些细节的性质,让我觉得不太适合……<<他啜了口茶,>>边((喝茶))边谈。
