English: I'm a mercenary, you see. I've fought with the Byonne Serpents, the Lundel Black Guard; and even the ((Dark Stars)), for a time.
Chinese: 要知道,我是个佣兵。我效力过拜昂巨蟒团、伦德尔黑卫队;甚至短暂待过((黑星佣兵团))。

English: And now... <<he sips his tea,>> I protect the business interests of this fine gentleman, nothing more. So please, pay me no heed.
Chinese: 而现在……<<他啜了口茶,>>我只是保护这位好先生的生意利益,仅此而已。所以请别把我放在心上。

English: <<He sips his tea quietly.>> Was there something else?
Chinese: <<他静静啜着茶。>>还有什么事吗?

English: Do you know of any... ((god-worshippers)) here?
Chinese: 你知道这儿有什么……((拜神者))吗?

English: Ah, so has old Culwych got you hunting down would-be Wikkans, then? <<He smirks.>>
Chinese: 啊,原来老卡尔威奇让你来猎捕准维坎教徒了?<<他得意一笑。>>

English: I really don't like to get involved in such matters. What people ascribe to - be it legal or otherwise - is no business of mine. I'm no lawman, after all.
Chinese: 我实在不喜欢掺和这种事。人们信奉什么——合法也罢,不合法也罢——与我无关。毕竟我又不是执法的。

English: <<He swirls his tea in its cup for a moment.>> Of course, it hardly needs stating that if I ((were)) looking for people involved in ((illicit)) deeds, I'd probably keep an eye out for what happens [[after nightfall]]. ##But that would just be stating the obvious.
Chinese: <<他晃了晃杯中的茶。>>当然,不必多说,假如我((真要))找那些干((非法))勾当的人,多半会留意[[夜幕降临之后]]的动静。 ##不过这只是句大白话罢了。

English: Some mercenaries are threatening Pwyll with a giant nautilob.
Chinese: 有些佣兵用巨型鹦鹉螺妖威胁普威尔。

English: <<He lets out a single, chuckle.>> You mean that bunch of idiots down in the ruins? Don't make me ((laugh)).
Chinese: <<他轻轻嗤笑一声。>>你是说废墟里那群蠢货?别逗我((笑))了。

English: Firstly, they're hardly fit to call themselves mercenaries. The mayor hired them to clear out monsters from the forest - a trifling task - and the show they put on was more fitting of a comedy troupe than professional sellswords.
Chinese: 首先,他们根本不配自称佣兵。镇长雇他们清剿森林里的怪物——不过小事一桩——结果那场表演更像是喜剧班子,而非职业雇佣剑士。

English: And secondly, there's [[no such thing as a giant nautilob]]. At least, I've sailed far and wide in my time, and never even heard of one larger than a silkslug. So the idea that those buffoons managed to ((capture)) one is preposterous.
Chinese: 其次,[[根本没有什么巨型鹦鹉螺妖]]。至少,我这辈子航海四方,从没听说过比丝蛞蝓更大的。所以那群小丑居然((抓住))了一只,简直是天方夜谭。

English: I'm guessing the mayor has asked you to look into the matter, hmm? Well, if I were you, I'd make use of [[your wits]] before drawing your sword. I sense there's some trickery at play, here.
Chinese: 我猜镇长是让你来查这件事的,嗯?换作是我,拔剑之前先动动[[脑子]]。我感觉到这里面有诈。

English: Is that scryshroom tea you're drinking?
Chinese: 你喝的是窥菇茶吗?

English: <<He is quiet a moment, and merely takes a sip.>> ##Indeed.
Chinese: <<他沉默片刻,只是啜了一口。>> ##没错。

English: Tell me, did ol' Dwynn over there give you his speech about how he ((outsmarted)) his business rivals by drinking the stuff?
Chinese: 说说看,那边老德温有没有跟你吹嘘过,他怎么靠喝这玩意((智胜))生意对手?

English: null
Chinese: null

English: null
Chinese: null

English: null
Chinese: null

English: Yes.
Chinese: 说过。

English: <<He smirks.>> I thought as much.
Chinese: <<他得意一笑。>>我就知道。

English: No.
Chinese: 没说过。

English: <<He smirks.>> Well I'm sorry for ((spoiling)) the tale for you.
Chinese: <<他得意一笑。>>很抱歉((剧透))了这个故事。

English: The funny thing is, he doesn't touch the stuff. It's more of a... sales tactic, you might say. Whenever he ((does)) drink scryshroom tea, he tends to get rather emotional and... <<He grins.>> ...empties his bowels prematurely.
Chinese: 有趣的是,他自己碰都不碰那玩意。那更像是……推销手段吧。每当((真))喝下窥菇茶,他就容易情绪激动,而且……<<他咧嘴一笑。>>……提前把肠子倒空。

English: You see, scryshroom may be a popular drug - but that's ((all)) it is to most people. A party trick or a quick high. The truth is, most can't ((see the future)) from drinking it. The shroom has such a potent psychedelic effect any premonitions are lost within the fantasy.
Chinese: 要知道,窥菇或许是大受欢迎的迷幻药——但对大多数人而言也就((仅此而已))。宴会上的把戏,或是一时的快感。事实上,大多数人喝了它((看不见未来))。这菇的迷幻效果太过强烈,任何预感都迷失在幻境之中。

English: But the premonitions ((are)) there. You just need a low dosage and a certain... discerning eye. That's why, if you were to - ((say)), reach for your blade right now - I'd have my ((knife at your throat)) before you knew it.
Chinese: 但预感((确实))存在。你只需要小剂量,再有一双……挑剔的眼睛。所以,假如你——((比方说))——现在伸手去摸剑,我会在你察觉之前就把((刀架上你的喉咙))。

English: <<He smiles warmly.>> Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: <<他温和地一笑。>>好了,还有别的事吗?

English: Tell me about your time as a mercenary.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲你当佣兵的日子吧。

English: <<Nudd tilts his head back and drums his fingers on his cup.>> Well, in my youth I toured with various mercenary companies in the Apostatic Union heartland; there's a tale or two there. ##I ended up with the Dark Stars here in Pwyll; a name I'm ((sure)) you've heard of.
Chinese: <<纳德仰起头,手指在杯上轻敲。>>嗯,年轻时我在叛教联盟腹地跟着各路佣兵团四处征战;故事有一箩筐。 ##最后我跟着黑星佣兵团来到普威尔;这名字你肯定((听说))过。

English: But lately I've been freelancing in these [[Oneiric Isles]]; taking on all sorts of jobs before settling in with Dwynn, here. Of all the realms I've been to, these isles host some of the strangest.
Chinese: 但近来我在这些[[梦幻群岛]]打零工;接了各式各样的活,最后才落脚到德温这儿。我去过的所有国度里,这些群岛的怪事最多。

English: I'm looking for some former Dark Star mercenaries.
Chinese: 我在找几个黑星佣兵团的前佣兵。

English: Well, as I told you, I used to sail with those lot - up until the [[mutiny]] that saw many of us take umbrage with Vela's unchecked ambition.
Chinese: 嗯,跟你说过了,我曾跟他们同船共渡——直到那场[[哗变]],我们许多人都受不了薇拉那失控的野心。

English: <<He narrows his eyes.>> Oh, is that ((so?)) ##Well, your motives better be pretty ((fucking)) congenial, 'cos it's no secret that I'm a former Dark Star merc myself.
Chinese: <<他眯起眼睛。>>哦,((是吗?)) ##那你最好图谋((他妈的))够正派,因为我本人就是前黑星佣兵,这不是什么秘密。

English: Of course, I haven't sailed with them in ((years.)) I left after the [[mutiny]], once it became clear that Vela's ambitions - once so ((intoxicating)) - were likely to get us all ((killed)).
Chinese: 当然,我已经((多年))没跟他们同船了。[[哗变]]之后我就离开了,当时薇拉的野心——曾经那么((令人陶醉))——显然要把我们全都((送上死路))。

English: <<He clears his throat.>> Well, ((out)) with it, then. Exactly ((who)) are you looking for?
Chinese: <<他清了清嗓子。>>那么,((说))吧。你到底在找((谁))?

English: I'm hunting Vela Callose.
Chinese: 我在追捕薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: Tell me about Vela Callose.
Chinese: 跟我说说薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: <<He chuckles heartily.>> Ah, now ((that's)) a good one. You're just gonna stride up to the boss lady herself and claim that Union bounty, are you?
Chinese: <<他放声大笑。>>哈,这个((好笑))。你要大摇大摆走到那位大姐头面前,去领联盟的悬赏,是吧?

English: Now, don't get me wrong. I never really ((knew)) the woman - I was too low rank to be clinking my tankard with her. But I've been privy to some of her deeds, and, well...
Chinese: 别误会。我从不曾真正((了解))那女人——我级别太低,没资格跟她碰杯。但我亲眼见识过她的些手段,呃……

English: ...let's just say you don't ((ever)) want to cross swords with ((Vela Callose)).
Chinese: ……这么说吧,你((永远))别想跟((薇拉·卡洛斯))刀剑相向。

English: As for where she's gone, I haven't the slightest idea - and I wouldn't tell you if I ((did)). ##That woman has plans in motion that I couldn't begin to comprehend, and I won't be found complicit in trying to ((thwart)) her efforts, for the sake of my own neck.
Chinese: 至于她去了哪儿,我半点不知——就算((知道))也不会告诉你。 ##那女人谋划着一些我根本无从理解的大计,为了我自己的小命,我可不想被发现在((阻挠))她。

English: I'm meeting with Jack Basalt.
Chinese: 我要去见杰克·巴索特。

English: I want to know about Jack Basalt.
Chinese: 我想了解杰克·巴索特。

English: Ah, good ol' Jack? <<He smirks.>> In the Union they still call him ((shame of the Navy)), after he abandoned his rank and station to join Vela's ((merry)) band.
Chinese: 啊,好老杰克?<<他得意一笑。>>联盟里至今还叫他((海军之耻)),因为他抛下军衔职位,投了薇拉那帮((快活))人马。

English: In battle the man was a ((demon)) - when his voice bellowed across the deck of a skyship, sword raised high, you made sure to ((heed)) it...
Chinese: 战场上这人是个((魔神))——当他的咆哮响彻天船甲板,手中长剑高举,你可得((依令))而行……

English: But below decks, he always found time to share a drink with those under his command. Learning their names, their troubles - not ((every)) merc captain does that.
Chinese: 但在甲板之下,他总能抽出空来与部下共饮。记得他们的名字,他们的难处——可不是((每个))佣兵队长都做得到。

English: Of course, I don't know if that was thanks to a kind heart, or his weakness for the ((strong stuff)). Let me guess... you're meeting in a pub, right? ##<<He grins.>>
Chinese: 当然,我说不好那是出于一副好心肠,还是他对((烈酒))的嗜好。让我猜猜……你们约在酒馆见面,对吧? ##<<他咧嘴一笑。>>

English: I'm looking for The Emberian.
Chinese: 我在找余烬人。

English: I'd like to hear about The Emberian.
Chinese: 我想听听余烬人的事。

English: Ah, I served under her on the [[Black Goblin]]. I think her real name was [[Orlaith]], but we just called her ((captain.))
Chinese: 啊,我在[[黑哥布林号]]上做过她的部下。她本名好像叫[[奥莱丝]],但我们只叫她((船长))。

English: She was always wearing that ancient [[Emberian Armour]], and was fascinated by anything of its like. We'd often stop off at some old rusty ruin so she could have a peek around. ##Some of the lads even got it in their heads that she really ((was)) an Emberian, somehow still alive after hundreds of years.
Chinese: 她总穿着那身古老的[[余烬铠甲]],对类似的物件痴迷不已。我们常在生锈的古代废墟落脚,好让她四处瞧瞧。 ##有些弟兄甚至认定她((真))是余烬人,不知怎么活了几百年。

English: I heard she was in [[Hallowshire]] somewhere, still scouring the countryside for rust-riddled relics. She was always a mysterious sort, so I doubt she'll be staying at a public house - but you'll probably want to ask the locals in [[Hallow Town]] if they've seen her.
Chinese: 听说她在[[哈洛郡]]某处,还在乡间四处搜寻锈迹斑斑的遗物。她向来神秘,我怀疑她不会住在酒馆——不过你可以去[[哈洛镇]]问问当地人有没有见过她。

English: I need to find The Duchess.
Chinese: 我得找到女公爵。

English: What do you know about The Duchess?
Chinese: 关于女公爵你知道些什么?

English: Ah, that [[Endless]] woman? I had few dealings with her, to be honest. She was ancient royalty ((and)) a cipher wizard - which made her ((doubly)) pretentious in my book.
Chinese: 啊,那个[[无尽者]]女人?说实话,我跟她没多少交集。她既是古老王族((又))是密文法师——在我看来,这就让她((加倍))地装腔作势。

English: I heard she had some sort of [[ancestral home]] in the [[Endless Realm.]] I've only been to those islands once or twice, so you'll have to ask around in the city of [[Sepulchre]] if you want to know more.
Chinese: 听说她在[[无尽领域]]有座[[祖宅]]。那些岛我只去过一两次,想了解更多,你得去[[陵墓城]]城里四处打听。

English: Do you know of Caxton Frost?
Chinese: 你可知道卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特?

English: Oh, that eccentric fellow? Handsome and ((clearly)) a genius? He was part of Vela's inner circle, so I only spoke to him once - and that night was kind of a ((blur)).
Chinese: 哦,那个怪人?英俊,而且((显然))是个天才?他在薇拉的核心圈子里,我只跟他说过一次话——那一晚有点((模糊))。

English: We were in the Wobbly Noggin and he rambled for hours about his theories on Emberian engineering. By the end of the night he was singing me songs from his native Kardova - that is, what the [[Clockwork Kingdom]] used to be called.
Chinese: 我们在摇晃酒馆,他絮絮叨叨讲了几个小时余烬工程学的理论。到了深夜,他给我唱起故乡卡尔多瓦的歌——也就是[[发条王国]]从前的名字。

English: I haven't heard a word about him since the mutiny. If he didn't die in the battle, maybe he returned to the [[Clockwork Kingdom]] - but that place is locked down, as of late.
Chinese: 哗变之后我就再没听过他的消息。要是他没死在那场仗里,也许回[[发条王国]]去了——但那地方近来封锁严密。

English: I did a job smuggling bottled visions from there a few star cycles back. Used a chap named [[Mikhail]] to ferry me across, but it was a fucking dangerous job - I wouldn't recommend it without good reason.
Chinese: 几个星辰周期前,我干过一单从那儿走私瓶装幻象的活。雇了个叫[[米哈伊尔]]的家伙渡我过去,但那活计他妈的危险——没有充分的理由,我劝你别碰。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就这些。

English: That's enough about Dark Stars.
Chinese: 黑星的事就问到这儿。

English: <<He holds his tea by his chest and says nothing.>>
Chinese: <<他把茶捧在胸前,一言不发。>>

English: I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 那我先走了。

English: <<He smiles politely, but says nothing.>>
Chinese: <<他礼貌地笑笑,却什么也没说。>>

English: Good. And let me be plain - you didn't hear any of this from ((me)), are we clear?
Chinese: 很好。让我把话说明白——这些话你可都是从((别人))那儿听来的,清楚吗?

English: Stop right there! This is the esteemed mercenary company headquarters of the [[Rotten Onions]]. None may pass without authorisation from our captain, [[John Birdbark]].
Chinese: 站住!这里是尊贵的[[烂洋葱佣兵团]]总部。未经我们的队长[[约翰·伯德巴克]]授权,任何人不得通过。

English: What kind of name is the ((Rotten Onions?))
Chinese: ((烂洋葱佣兵团?))这算什么名字?

English: It's a ((very fine name)), I'll have you know! Birdbark is an esteemed scholar and battle-wizard, as well as our captain. It's ((his)) reasonin' that it's a name designed to strike ((fear)) in our enemies.
Chinese: 你给我听好了,这可是个((响当当的名字))!伯德巴克是德高望重的学者兼战斗法师,还是我们的队长。((他))认为,这名字天生就能让敌人((闻风丧胆))。

English: And how does ((that)) work?
Chinese: 那((是))怎么个威慑法?

English: Well... it's seni... um, semiobtic... ((semiotics)), see? Like words an' their meaning an' stuff?
Chinese: 呃……这是符……呃,符号家……((符号学)),懂吗?就是文字啊、含义啊之类的?

English: Yes, but why do onions strike fear into the hearts of your enemies?
Chinese: 是,可为什么洋葱能让敌人闻风丧胆?

English: <<The guard tilts his head and scratches his jaw.>> Well, people don't ((like)) onions, see? They makes you cry. And rotten ones are even ((worse)).
Chinese: <<卫兵歪着头,挠了挠下巴。>>呃,人们((讨厌))洋葱,懂吗?洋葱让人流泪。烂洋葱就更((糟))了。

English: Never mind, I give up.
Chinese: 算了,我放弃。

English: <<The guard nods, evidently satisfied.>>
Chinese: <<卫兵点点头,显然很满意。>>

English: Right. Yes. ((Sure)).
<<The guard nods, evidently satisfied.>>
Chinese: <<卫兵点点头,显然很满意。>>

English: It's a stupid name.
Chinese: 这名字真蠢。

English: <<The guard looks visibly hurt.>> W-w-well you don't ((have)) to think it's clever. We'll just stab you all the same.
Chinese: <<卫兵一脸受伤。>>那——那你也((不必))觉得它聪明。反正我们照捅不误。

English: What's with that giant monster?
Chinese: 那只巨型怪物是怎么回事?

English: Oh, it's a [[giant nautilob]]. Pretty ((scary)) huh? <<He leans close and chuckles, but you don't quite get the joke.>>
Chinese: 哦,那是只[[巨型鹦鹉螺妖]]。挺((吓人))的吧?<<他凑近轻笑,但你没太懂笑点在哪。>>

English: Y'see, the [[mayor of Pwyll]] hired us to do a job, but she's refusin' to pay up. So we're gonna sack the place unless she hands over the coin.
Chinese: 你瞧,[[普威尔镇长]]雇我们干活,可她赖着不付钱。所以她不交出硬币,我们就洗劫这地方。

English: I found that ledger you wanted.
Chinese: 我找到了你们要的账本。

English: Really? Hand it over! ##<<He rifles through the pages of the ledger.>> Yeah, this looks about right. Oh boy, is the captain gonna be pleased with this!
Chinese: 真的?交出来! ##<<他哗啦啦翻过账本的页。>>对,就是它。天哪,队长见到这个准乐坏了!

English: Well, I guess you can walk on through, then. I'll shout to the boys an' let 'em know you're alright.
Chinese: 嗯,那你可以过去了。我朝弟兄们喊一嗓子,告诉他们你没危险。

English: I want to get inside your headquarters.
Chinese: 我想进你们的总部。

English: Well, you can't. <<He scratches his jaw.>> Unless... you get us the [[mayor's ledger]].
Chinese: 呃,不行。<<他挠挠下巴。>>除非……你把[[镇长的账本]]弄来。

English: What's this about a ledger?
Chinese: 账本是怎么回事?

English: Well, the mayor of Pwyll hired us to clear out some monsters in the shroom forest. Sure, we ran into some ((difficulties)), but a job's a job. An' she's not payin' up!
Chinese: 呃,普威尔镇长雇我们清剿蘑菇林里的几只怪物。诚然,我们碰上了些((麻烦)),但活就是活。可她赖账不付!

English: So, captain reckons if we steal her [[ledger]], we'll have proof an' can take it to the Riovan Court of Slaw.
Chinese: 所以,队长琢磨着,要是偷来她的[[账本]],我们就有证据,可以呈交里奥瓦凉拌法庭。

English: Court of ((slaw))?
Chinese: ((凉拌))法庭?

English: Yup. It's a type of side dish.
Chinese: 对。凉拌是种配菜。

English: I think you mean ((court of law)).
Chinese: 我想你想说的是((正式法庭))。

English: <<He shoots you an angry glare.>> I know what I meant, ((friend)). The Riovan Court of Slaw.
Chinese: <<他恼火地瞪你。>>我清楚自己想说什么,((朋友))。里奥瓦凉拌法庭。

English: Never mind.
Chinese: 当我没说。

English: <<He nods victoriously.>>
Chinese: <<他得意地点点头。>>

English: And how can I get this ledger?
Chinese: 那我怎么拿到这本账本?

English: Well, I'd sneak in [[at night]] while the mayor's asleep, of course. Then bring it back to me, an' you'll officially be a friend of the Rotten Onions.
Chinese: 嗯,当然要趁镇长睡觉时[[夜里]]溜进去。然后把它带回来给我,你就正式成为烂洋葱佣兵团的朋友了。

English: @@I'm just a huge fan of the Rotten Onions. I'd ((love)) to see where you work.
Chinese: @@我就是烂洋葱佣兵团的超级粉丝。我((非常想))看看你们工作的地方。

English: %%<<He looks flattered.>> You've heard of us? You really have? ##<<He thinks a moment.>> Well, there's only one of you, so I reckon a quick snoop can't hurt...
Chinese: %%<<他一脸受宠若惊。>>你听说过我们?真的? ##<<他想了想。>>呃,你就一个人,我想快速参观一下应该无妨……

English: Alright, you're free to go in.
Chinese: 行,你可以进去了。

English: &&Ha! I'm not fallin' for ((that)) one. ##...uh, not ((again)), anyway.
Chinese: &&哈!我可不会((上当))。 ##……呃,至少不会((再))上当。

English: Well maybe I'm just gonna walk in anyway.
Chinese: 那我说不定就直接闯进去了。

English: H-h-hold it! If you just ((stride)) in there, I'm gonna have no ((choice)) but to... um... cut you down! So don't go tryin' anything stupid, right?
Chinese: 站——站住!你要是就这么((大摇大摆))闯进去,我就没有((办法)),只能……呃……把你砍倒!所以别想干蠢事,听见没?

English: Alright, I get the picture.
Chinese: 行,我明白了。

English: <<He nods.>>
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>

English: Okay, I'll be going.
Chinese: 好,我先走了。

English: Greetins again, friend. Feel free to walk right on in.
Chinese: 又见面了,朋友。请随意进去吧。

English: Godsdamnit. Some pillock let slip that our giant monster's actually jus' an ((enchanted balloon)), so looks like it's still gonna be boot leather for dinner.
Chinese: 该死。某个蠢货走漏了风声,说我们那只巨型怪物其实只是个((施了法的气球)),看来晚餐还是只能啃靴子皮了。

English: Well, captain's not so bothered about security right now, seein' as he's mostly weepin' in his chambers, so I reckon you can go right on in.
Chinese: 呃,队长眼下顾不上安保,他正在房间里抹眼泪呢,所以我想你可以直接进去。

English: <<You realize that the>> [[Ledger]] <<is missing from your pockets. How strange...>>
Chinese: <<你发现>>[[账本]]<<不在你口袋里了。真奇怪……>>

English: Hmph, I don't recall admitting any visitors! I'm the esteemed captain of the Rotten Onion mercenary group, John Birdbark - and I do ((not)) remember summoning you into my bedchambers.
Chinese: 哼,我可没记得放行过任何访客!我是尊贵的烂洋葱佣兵团队长约翰·伯德巴克——我((绝对))没记得传召你进我的寝帐。

English: Hmph, it's ((you)) again.
Chinese: 哼,又是((你))。

English: I gave your guard the mayor's ledger.
Chinese: 我把镇长的账本交给你的卫兵了。

English: Ah, so that was ((you))? Splendid, splendid! It will provide ample fuel for my fireplace.
Chinese: 啊,原来是((你))?好极了,好极了!它够我壁炉烧一阵子了。

English: Wait, you're not going to ((do)) anything with it?
Chinese: 等等,你不打算拿它((做))点什么?

English: Well, I spun the company some silly yarn about being able to get ((compensation)), or somesuch. But really I just wanted to cause that damned mayor a significant ((inconvenience)). Oh, I wish I could see her face - how ((mildly annoyed)) she must be!
Chinese: 嗯,我跟团里那帮人胡扯了一通什么能拿到((赔偿))之类的鬼话。但其实我只想给那个该死的女镇长添个大((麻烦)). 哦,真想看看她的表情——她一定((微微恼火))得很!

English: Uh... no problem.
Chinese: 呃……没关系。

English: Now, are you going to... leave?
Chinese: 那么,你要不要……离开?

English: I wanted to ask about that giant monster.
Chinese: 我想问问那只巨型怪物。

English: Hmm, oh yes! Quite the ((frightful)) thing, eh? I'm sure it's giving that wretched mayor a sleepless night or two. <<He chuckles.>>
Chinese: 嗯,哦对!相当((骇人))的东西,对吧?我敢说那可恶的女镇长得为它失眠一两晚了。<<他咯咯直笑。>>

English: @@So how'd you get your hands on such a beast, eh? You can tell me.
Chinese: @@那你们是怎么弄到这么头怪物的,嗯?跟我说说嘛。

English: %%Well... Hmm... alright then, you seem like the trustworthy sort.
Chinese: %%这个……嗯……好吧,你看着倒像靠得住的人。

English: Here's the really ((clever)) thing - it's not actually a monster at all! It's just a giant balloon with an illusion spell cast on it. ((Ingenious)), no?
Chinese: 最((高明))的地方在这儿——它根本不是什么怪物!就是一只巨大的气球,施了个幻象咒。((巧妙)),吧?

English: Oh, I have absolutely no intent on sacking the town. Truth be told, I'm not sure my men could sack a ((nursery)). But maybe we'll scare them into giving us some coin, eh?
Chinese: 哦,我压根没打算洗劫镇子。说实话,我都不确定我那帮弟兄洗劫得了((托儿所))。不过也许能吓唬他们给我们几个硬币,嗯?

English: &&Hmph! Well... a lady never tells. <<He winks.>>
Chinese: &&哼!这个嘛……淑女从不透露。<<他眨眨眼。>>

English: About something else...
Chinese: 关于别的事……

English: Oh, ((do)) make it quick...
Chinese: 哦,((务必))快一点……

English: What kind of name is Rotten Onion, anyway?
Chinese: 烂洋葱到底算个什么名字?

English: Well, a ((terrible)) one, of course. The previous name turned out to be a rather nasty ((slur)) in Slev - so we had to come up with a new one pretty quickly in a tavern. I suggested the name ((Golden Galleon)) - which I thought went down rather well.
Chinese: 呃,当然是个((糟透))的名字。之前的名字在斯列夫竟然是句相当难听的((脏话))——所以我们只好在酒馆里匆匆现起一个。我提议叫((黄金大帆船))——我觉得反响相当不错。

English: But it turned out that the men had completely misheard me in the clamour of the pub. The next day, everyone was commending me on what an excellent name 'Rotten Onion' was. And once you get an idea into these buffon's heads, it's ((very)) hard to get it out.
Chinese: 结果在酒馆的喧闹声中,弟兄们完全听岔了我的话。第二天,人人都夸'烂洋葱'这名字起得妙极了。而一旦这些蠢货脑袋里装进一个想法,((很难))再抠出来。

English: Sorry, I'll just be going...
Chinese: 抱歉,我就先走了……

English: Yes, if you ((would!))
Seein' that giant nautilob up there...? Makes me proud to call myself a ((Smelly Onion.))
Chinese: 看到头顶那只巨型鹦鹉螺妖……?让我很自豪能自称一只((臭洋葱))。

English: ...whassat? No, I'm certain it's ((Smelly)) Onion. I think I'd know my ((own)) merc company name!
Chinese: ……什么?不,我确定是((臭))洋葱。我总该知道((自己))佣兵团的名字吧!

English: People are always chattin' about those ((Dark Stars)) and their ((Vela Callose.)) But one day... one day they'll be talking about the ((Rotten Onions!)) And our... ((our))...
Chinese: 人们总在议论那些((黑星佣兵团))和他们的((薇拉·卡洛斯))。但总有一天……总有一天大家会谈起((烂洋葱佣兵团!))还有我们的……((我们的))……

English: ((Oh gods. What's our leader's name again?))
Chinese: ((天哪诸神。我们头儿叫什么来着?))

English: These ol' God War fortresses sure are strange, what with everything made out of metal, an' all. If you ask me, boxes n' boats should be made o' ((wood.))
Chinese: 这些古老的神战堡垒真是怪得很,全是金属造的什么的。要我说,箱子啊船啊就该用((木头))造。

English: Gods, my feet ache from patrolling all day. Who's gonna bother to rob us anyways? We're broke!
Chinese: 诸神在上,巡逻一整天,我脚都酸了。再说了,谁会费劲来抢我们?我们都穷光了!

English: You may've charmed the others, but I've got my eye on you.
Chinese: 你也许迷惑了别人,但我可盯着你呢。

English: <<The farmhand sits aimlessly, watching the mushrooms.>>
Chinese: <<雇农茫然地坐着,望着蘑菇。>>

English: Busy day?
Chinese: 今天忙吗?

English: <<You startle the farmhand.>> Hmm? Oh, Emyr wasn't slackin' off, oh no! Issjust... there ain't much to do around here lately, on account o' the poor shroom yield.
Chinese: <<你吓了雇农一跳。>>嗯?哦,埃米尔没有偷懒,才没有!只是……近来这儿实在没活可干,蘑菇收成太差了。

English: Each year the harvests get leaner an' leaner. Dwynn says it'll be fine, but I don't think even ((he)) believes it.
Chinese: 收成一年比一年薄。德温说没事,可我看连((他))自己都不信。

English: Last time I took scryshroom, I saw a vision of Pwyll, barren an' bare, the houses all ruined. Honestly, unless we ((do)) summin', this town ain't got much of a future, I reckon...
Chinese: 上回我吃了窥菇,看见了普威尔的幻象,荒芜一片,房屋尽毁。说真的,除非我们((干))点什么,这镇子没什么未来,我看……

English: Have you heard of any god-worshippers around here?
Chinese: 你听说过附近有拜神者吗?

English: <<He looks suddenly nervous.>> Emyr don't know nuffin', y'hear? If I get caught talkin' about that kinda stuff, Culwych'll go an' weigh me on those scary scales o' his...
Chinese: <<他突然紧张起来。>>埃米尔什么都不知道,听见没?要是我被抓到谈论那种事,卡尔威奇会拿他那吓人的天平来称我……

English: I'll leave you to it.
Chinese: 不打扰你了。

English: <<He returns to staring at the mushrooms.>>
Chinese: <<他继续望着蘑菇。>>

English: So yer stopped Lludd from sacrificin' hisself, eh? Gotta admit, part o' me's relieved.
Chinese: 这么说你拦下了卢德,没让他把自己献祭掉,嗯?不得不说,我心里松了口气。

English: So he really went an ((did)) it, eh? Lludd, sacrificin' hisself for the good o' Pwyll. Gotta admit, I'm glad the village is saved an' all, but it don't make me feel good knowin' Lludd's gone. Not good at all.
Chinese: 所以他真的((干))了,嗯?卢德,为了普威尔把自己献祭了。不得不承认,村子得救我高兴,可一想到卢德没了,心里就不是滋味。很不是滋味。

English: Guess I should come clean an' say... that were me, in the Wikkan robes, conductin' the Wikkan ritual. It were all stuff we found in the mayor's basement - old stuff from before the war, an' the like.
Chinese: 我想我该坦白……穿维坎长袍、主持维坎仪式的,就是我。那些都是我们在镇长地下室里翻出来的——战前的老物件之类。

English: I wanted to save the village an' all, but I did say to Lludd, d'ya ((really)) wanna do this, y'know? I never wanted anyone to ((die)) over it.
Chinese: 我也想救村子来着,可我确实问过卢德,你((真))想干这个吗,你知道吗?我从没想让任何人为此((送命))。

English: Just... don't mention me to ol' Culwych, will ya? I didn't really know what I was gettin' myself into. I don' wanna rot in some prison cell...
Chinese: 只是……别跟老卡尔威奇提起我,行吗?我真不知道自己卷进了什么。我可不想烂在什么牢房里……

English: <<In the darkness and under such a thick hood, you can't make out the person's face.>> ##Get ((away)) from me, y'hear? You shouldn't ((be)) here. Come any close an' I swear, ye'll regret it...
Chinese: <<黑暗之中,厚兜帽之下,你看不清那人的脸。>> ##离((远))点,听见没?你不该((来))这儿。再靠近我就要动手,你听好了,你会后悔的……

English: Hmph, what's this - ((another)) drop in? I thought I ((told)) Dwynn to stop giving a key to any ol' breather.
Chinese: 哼,这是什么——((又))来一位?我不是((说过))让德温别随便给哪个呼吸者配钥匙吗。

English: <<She lets out a raspy sigh.>> Look, I'm sure you know the drill, but... tell ((anyone)) about our little smuggling enterprise and you'll get a blade in the gut. <<Her torn lips form a mockery of a smile.>> ##Got it?
Chinese: <<她发出沙哑的叹息。>>听着,我相信你懂规矩,但是……把我们这桩小小的走私买卖告诉((任何人)),你就得挨一刀,捅进肚子里。<<她残破的嘴唇挤出个扭曲的笑。>> ##明白?

English: <<She claps her hands together.>> Well, with the ((pleasantries)) out the way, what'll it be? You looking to move some goods - or you after a [[Union Passport?]]
Chinese: <<她拍了拍手。>>好了,((客套))完了,你想怎么样?是想运点货——还是想要一张[[联盟护照?]]

English: You again, eh? Well, what'll it be?
Chinese: 又是你,嗯?那,想怎么样?

English: Let me see what you have for sale.
Chinese: 让我看看你卖什么。

English: <<She nods.>> And ((obviously)) you didn't get it from me, right?
Chinese: <<她点点头。>>而且((显然))不是从我这儿买的,对吧?

English: You look a little... worse for wear.
Chinese: 你看起来有点……憔悴。

English: What, you never seen an [[Endless]] before? ##<<She coughs.>> Bet you haven't, an' all.
Chinese: 怎么,没见过[[无尽者]]? ##<<她咳了一声。>>我猜你也没见过。

English: Well, the name's Ghutrid, an' I'm six hundred-an-somethin' years old. Forgive me if I can't recall the ((exact)) number - the last hundred 'ave been a bit of a ((drag.))
Chinese: 嗯,我叫古特里德,六百多岁了。要是记不清((确切))数字,还请见谅——最近一百年有点((难熬))。

English: Anyways, I'm not a bloody emissary for the [[Endless Realm]]. You can see its rotten trees an' mausoleum spires from Pwyll - so if you ((really)) wanna know the ((delights)) of eternal life in a dusty tomb, you can go visit sometime.
Chinese: 总之,我才不是[[无尽领域]]的什么该死使者。从普威尔就能望见它的烂树和陵墓尖塔——所以你要是((真))想了解尘封墓穴里永生的((妙处)),大可改天去看看。

English: Your Union Passports - do they work?
Chinese: 你的联盟护照——好用吗?

English: Well if they ((didn't)), I'm not likely to tell you now, am I? ##How's this; if the feller at the gatebridge susses it's a forgery, I'll come give you a friendly visit at your Inquisition prison cell. Satisfied?
Chinese: 要是((不好用)),我现在也不会告诉你,对吧? ##这样吧;要是关卡桥那家伙看出是伪造的,我就去宗教裁判所牢房给你来个友好的探监。满意了吧?

English: So, if you want one, just have a look through [[my stock.]]
Chinese: 所以,想要的话,就去翻翻[[我的货]]吧。

English: What's with the portal in the back?
Chinese: 后面那道传送门是怎么回事?

English: <<She grins.>> Ah, an old family heirloom, shall we say. Us Endless are fond of our portal mirrors, even if they often lead you to the arse-end of a mausoleum. ##Thought I might as well make ((good use)) of a pair, an' struck up this little partnership with Dwynn.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴一笑。>>啊,算是件传家的老物件吧。我们无尽者都钟爱自家的传送镜,哪怕它们常把你送到陵墓的荒屁股角。 ##我想着不如把它们((物尽其用)),就跟德温搭成了这桩小买卖。

English: That one leads right to the [[Lost Purse]] in [[Hallow Town]]. Let's just say the folk over there share a mutual distaste for Union taxes. <<She chuckles.>>
Chinese: 那道门直通[[哈洛镇]]的[[失包黑店]]。这么说吧,那边的人也跟联盟的税收八字不合。<<她咯咯直笑。>>

English: Only, they keep the room barred from the other side unless we have a delivery, so don't go snoopin', now.
Chinese: 只是没货的时候,他们会从那边把房间闩死,所以别去乱翻,听见没。

English: I'll be going.
Chinese: 我先走了。

English: Right. An' not a word to anyone, y'hear?
Chinese: 好。跟谁都不许提一个字,听见没?

English: Stop right there! <<The man brandishes a particularly rusty sword in your direction.>>##Y'er not... ((ticking)), are ye? No metallic limbs? Leaky joints?
Chinese: 站住!<<那男人朝你挥舞着一把锈得厉害的剑。>> ##你不是……((滴答作响))的那种吧?没有金属四肢?漏油的关节?

English: Why would I be... ((ticking))?
Chinese: 我为什么会……((滴答作响))?

English: Because ye might be a ((mechanical contraption)), hidin' in the ((skin)) of a person! ##<<He gasps for air and blinks at you.>>
Chinese: 因为你可能是个((机械装置)),藏在人的((皮))底下! ##<<他喘着粗气,冲你直眨眼。>>

English: Well, don't look at me like I'm ((daft!)) It's a perfectly reasonable suspicion!
Chinese: 喂,别拿那种眼神看我,以为我((疯了))!这怀疑完全合理!

English: Yes! I am in fact, a ((clock.))
Chinese: 对!其实我就是个((时钟))。

English: <<The man gasps.>> Ah! I knew it! These fiendish contraptions are gettin' more fanciful by the day!
Chinese: <<男人倒吸一口气。>>啊!我就知道!这些邪恶装置一天比一天花样多!

English: <<The man steps closer and prods you a few times with his finger.>> Hmm.
Chinese: <<男人走近,用手指戳了你几下。>>嗯。

English: Get off me, old man!
Chinese: 放开我,老头!

English: Y'er in ((my)) house! I'll do as I damn well please. ##<<He scowls at you for a moment.>>
Chinese: 这可是在((我))家!老子想干什么就干什么。 ##<<他冲你皱了会儿眉。>>

English: ((Allow him to continue.))
Chinese: ((任他继续戳。))

English: <<He prods you a few more times.>> Hmmmm.
Chinese: <<他又戳了你几下。>>嗯嗯嗯。

English: Gah! Well I'll admit, you don't ((seem)) like a mindless killin' machine from that blasted [[Clockwork Kingdom]]. It's just, since the [[attacks]] I've been pretty jumpy.
Chinese: 呸!好吧我承认,你((不像))是那该死的[[发条王国]]来的没脑子的杀戮机器。只是自从那些[[袭击]]之后,我一直神经兮兮的。

English: Tell me about the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 跟我说说发条王国。

English: These [[Oneiric Isles]] are home to a certain [[Clockwork Kingdom]], due [[east]] of this 'ere hamlet of Pwyll.
Chinese: 这些[[梦幻群岛]]中有个[[发条王国]],就在普威尔小村[[正东]]边。

English: What's that about a ((Clockwork Kingdom?))
Chinese: ((发条王国))是什么?

English: Hmph, new here, are ye? These [[Oneiric Isles]] are home to a certain [[Clockwork Kingdom]], due [[east]] of this 'ere hamlet of Pwyll.
Chinese: 哼,新来的,是吧?这些[[梦幻群岛]]中有个[[发条王国]],就在普威尔小村[[正东]]边。

English: For a while they were decent enough neighbours - 'cept for those bothersome factories billowing out smoke an' the occasional explosion rockin' the whole isle somethin' fierce.
Chinese: 有那么一阵子,他们还算体面的邻居——就是那些工厂浓烟滚滚烦人得很,偶尔的爆炸还震得整座岛七荤八素。

English: But folk say their machine-king went mad, an' now somma their gadgets and gizmos are spillin' cross the border an' wreaking havoc with my crops.
Chinese: 可人们说他们的机器王疯了,如今他们那些小玩意零零碎碎越过边境,把我的庄稼折腾得一塌糊涂。

English: Did you say you were getting attacked?
Chinese: 你是说你们遭到了袭击?

English: <<He sighs.>> Aye. By mechanical monstrosities. ##<<He frowns at you.>> An' don't ((laugh))! I'm bein' sincere!
Chinese: <<他叹了口气。>>对。被机械怪物。 ##<<他冲你皱眉。>>别((笑))!我可是认真的!

English: They've been coming from the east; where the snow's been fallin'. Funny thing - it never ((used)) to snow here.
Chinese: 它们从东边来;那边一直在下雪。怪就怪在——这儿从前((从来))不下雪。

English: At first they were jus' little things. But lately, one [[huge metal bastard]] 'as taken to ((tending)) my crop shrooms with its weapons. If I try and shoo it away, it attacks!
Chinese: 起初不过是些小东西。可近来,有个[[巨大的金属混账]]开始用武器((照看))我的作物蘑菇。我一赶它,它就动手!

English: I think I've already dealt with that.
Chinese: 我想我已经摆平它了。

English: <<His eyes open wide.>> You ((have?)) And there was me thinking anyone ((foolish)) enough to try would be hacked into tiny pieces! <<He chuckles.>>
Chinese: <<他瞪大眼睛。>>你((摆平了?))我还以为谁((敢))去试都会被剁成碎片呢!<<他咯咯直笑。>>

English: I could try and shut it down for you.
Chinese: 我可以帮你把它关掉。

English: You would? Oh, I'd by mighty 'preciative. If you manage to do it, there'd be some [[coin]] in it for you.
Chinese: 你愿意?哦,那可太感谢了。你要是办成了,有你一份[[硬币]]。

English: The machine seems t' lurk in the [[snow-tipped mountain to the east]]. Simplest way o' dealin' with it would be to [[smash it to pieces]], but... its [[armour]] will deflect any blow that 'aint [[strong enough.]]
Chinese: 那机器似乎潜伏在[[东边积雪的山]]上。最简单的办法就是[[把它砸个稀烂]],但……它的[[装甲]]会弹开一切[[不够猛]]的攻击。

English: So maybe there's some way o' shuttin' it down? There were a couple o' suspicious [[container crates]] that fell in the [[forest around here]].
Chinese: 所以也许有办法把它关掉?附近[[森林]]里掉落过几个可疑的[[集装箱板条箱]]。

English: Well, good luck with that, old man.
Chinese: 那,祝你好运,老头。

English: <<He scoffs.>> Aye, an' I'll need it.
Chinese: <<他嗤之以鼻。>>是啊,我确实需要。

English: Can you tell me about that machine that's been bothering you?
Chinese: 能讲讲那台烦你的机器吗?

English: I've got to get going.
Chinese: 我得走了。

English: <<He nods.>>
Chinese: <<他点点头。>>

English: I've dealt with the machine that's been bothering you.
Chinese: 那台烦你的机器我已经摆平了。

English: <<His eyes open wide.>> You ((have?)) And there was me thinking you'd be hacked into tiny pieces! <<He chuckles.>>
Chinese: <<他瞪大眼睛。>>你((摆平了?))我还以为你会被剁成碎片呢!<<他咯咯直笑。>>

English: So tell me, how'd you do it?
Chinese: 快说说,你是怎么办到的?

English: I kept smashing it until it stopped moving.
Chinese: 我一直砸到它不动为止。

English: <<He nods in appreciation.>> Like my pa used to say, If you can solve any problem with violence; you'll do alright in this world.
Chinese: <<他赞赏地点点头。>>正如我老爹常说的:能用暴力解决的问题,你在这世上就饿不死。

English: <<He clears his throat.>> O' course, my pa died in a pub brawl, rest 'is soul. But ((in this case)) I s'pose he was right.
Chinese: <<他清了清嗓子。>>当然,我老爹是在酒馆斗殴里丧命的,愿他安息。不过((就这事儿))而言,我觉得他说得对。

English: Anyway, it's not much, but I have some [[coin]] stashed away here. Please accept it, along with my 'eartfelt thanks.
Chinese: 总之,不多,但我这儿存了些[[硬币]]。请收下,连同我由衷的感谢。

English: I managed to disable it remotely.
Chinese: 我成功远程把它关掉了。

English: <<He taps his forehead.>> Ah, a clever one, are we?
Chinese: <<他敲敲脑门。>>啊,还是个机灵鬼?

English: Well, it's not much, but I have some [[coin]] stashed away here. Please accept it, along with my 'eartfelt thanks.
Chinese: 嗯,不多,但我这儿存了些[[硬币]]。请收下,连同我由衷的感谢。

English: I changed its protocols; it should tend your farm peacefully, now.
Chinese: 我改了它的协议;现在它应该会安分地照看你的农场了。

English: <<He seems taken aback.>> You... changed its ((what)) now? So y'mean it's all ((friendly)) all of a sudden?
Chinese: <<他似乎吃了一惊。>>你……改了它的((什么))?你是说它一下子就((友好))了?

English: <<He strokes his chin.>> Hmm. If this ((works)), and that machine proves even half as useful as I 'eard they were... why, I'll be the ((richest)) shroom-tender in Pwyll...
Chinese: <<他摸着下巴。>>嗯。要是这((行得通)),那机器哪怕只有我听说的一半好用……嘿,我就要成普威尔最((有钱))的蘑菇农了……

English: <<He breaks into a beaming grin.>>  Maybe even in ((Hallowshire...))
Chinese: <<他绽出灿烂的笑容。>>搞不好是整个((哈洛郡……))

English: Thank you, stranger - truly. ##I have here an old [[family heirloom]] that should be worth a few bob to the traders in Hallow Town - please, take it. You've ((earned)) it.
Chinese: 谢谢你,陌生人——真心实意。 ##我这儿有件祖传的[[传家宝]],在哈洛镇的商人那儿应该值几个钱——请收下。你((应得))的。

English: Hmph. Sorry if I'm a bit distracted, traveller; that blasted [[mech]] from the [[Clockwork Kingdom]] is still ravaging my crops.
Chinese: 哼。抱歉我有点心不在焉,旅人;那台从[[发条王国]]来的该死[[机兵]]还在祸害我的庄稼。

English: Ah, if it isn't my favourite passer-by. I gotta tell you, things 'ave been much more peaceful around 'ere since you took care of that blasted machine.
Chinese: 啊,这不是我最喜欢的过路人嘛。跟你说,自从你摆平了那台该死的机器,这儿太平多了。

English: Ah, if it isn't my favourite passer-by! ##I gotta tell you, since you tinkered with that robot and made it all friendly, my crop yields 'ave been ((bountiful.))
Chinese: 啊,这不是我最喜欢的过路人嘛! ##跟你说,自从你把那机器人调教得服服帖帖,我的收成就((大丰收))了。

English: <<He scoffs.>>Are you just pullin' my leg?
Chinese: <<他嗤之以鼻。>>你不会是拿我寻开心吧?

English: <<The device crackles with the distinct pulse of cipher-magic. Its ocular-skull registers your presence and a mechanical quill scratches out the following lines:>>
Chinese: <<装置噼啪作响,密文魔法的搏动清晰可辨。它的颅骨之眼登记下你的存在,一支机械羽笔沙沙写出如下文字:>>

English: [[REJOICE]], DOWNTRODDEN THRALL OF THE DEFEATIST POWERS! THOU STANDEST NOW WITHIN A FIEFDOM OF MACHINUS REX.
Chinese: [[欢庆吧]],丧权势力下受尽欺凌的奴仆!汝此刻正立于机械王陛下的领地之内。

English: [[PROCLAMATION]]: THIS HONOURABLE VASSAL GOVERNS THE PROTOCOLS OF ITS INDENTURED AUTO-SERFS. ##DESCRYING CENSUS...
Chinese: [[宣告]]:本尊贵封臣执掌其契约自动农奴之规程。 ##正在勘察人口……

English: NUMBER OF INACTIVE AUTO-SERFS: [[253]]. ##NUMBER OF ACTIVE AUTO-SERFS =: [[1]]. ##CURRENT LABOUR PROTOCOL: [[MILITANT AGRICULTURE]].
Chinese: 未激活自动农奴数目:[[253]]。 ##激活自动农奴数目:[[1]]。 ##现行劳作规程:[[好斗农耕]]。

English: DOST THOU HAVE A QUERY?
Chinese: 汝有疑问乎?

English: What if I just smash you up? Will that stop the robots from working?
Chinese: 要是我直接把你砸了,那些机器人就会停下吗?

English: PONDERING... ##[[JUDGEMENT]]: CESSATION OF DUTIES IS ONLY PERMITTED BY ORDER OF MACHINUS REX OR ITS APPOINTED DEPUTIES. THEREFORE, [[EDICT]]: THY PETITION IS DENIED.
Chinese: 思忖中…… ##[[裁定]]:唯有机械王陛下或其委任副手下令,方可终止职守。故而,[[敕令]]:汝之请示,驳回。

English: I want to shut down the machine in your service.
Chinese: 我想关闭为你效力的那台机器。

English: [[AXIOM]]: ASSAULT OF A ROYAL VASSAL IS TREASON, & MAY BE ADJUDGED AN ACT OF WAR. THEREFORE, [[EDICT]]: THOU SHALT NOT LAY A HAND UPON THIS VASSAL.
Chinese: [[公理]]:袭皇家封臣即叛国,并可裁为战争行径。故而,[[敕令]]:汝不得对本案封臣动手。

English: ((Give the thing a whack)).
Chinese: ((给这玩意一拳))。

English: <<You strike the machine. It doesn't take much force for it to sputter and stop. After a few moments, you are satisfied the thing has stopped working.>>
Chinese: <<你一击命中机器。没费多大力气,它便噼啪作响着停了下来。片刻之后,你确信这玩意已经罢工。>>

English: Never mind.
Chinese: 算了。

English: I want to change the, uh, labour protocols.
Chinese: 我想改一下那个,呃,劳作规程。

English: PONDERING... ##[[JUDGEMENT]]: ALTERATION OF PROTOCOLS IS ONLY PERMITTED BY ORDER OF MACHINUS REX OR ITS APPOINTED DEPUTIES, OR BY THE ORDAINED DISCRETION OF THIS VASSAL. THEREFORE, [[QUERY]]: WHAT IS THINE ARGUMENT?
Chinese: 思忖中…… ##[[裁定]]:唯有机械王陛下或其委任副手下令,或经本案封臣受命裁量,方可变更规程。故而,[[质询]]:汝有何论据?

English: @@Your serf is causing havoc and will likely be destroyed, unless you tell it to calm down.
Chinese: @@你的农奴正在肆虐,若不命它安分,恐将被人摧毁。

English: &&CONTEMPLATING CANON(Disputation)... ASSAYING VALIDITY... ##[[JUDGEMENT]: THINE ARGUMENT IS UNWORTHY. THEREFORE, [[EDICT]]: THIS VASSAL WILL CONTINUE ITS DUTIES.
Chinese: &&思量圣典(辩争)……检验效力…… ##[[裁定]:汝之论据不足取。故而,[[敕令]]:本案封臣将继续恪尽职守。

English: %%CONTEMPLATING CANON(Disputation)... ASSAYING VALIDITY... ##[[JUDGEMENT]]: THINE ARGUMENT IS WORTHY.
Chinese: %%思量圣典(辩争)……检验效力…… ##[[裁定]]:汝之论据确凿有理。

English: THEREFORE, [[EDICT]]: AUTO-SERF LABOUR PROTOCOL IS HEREBY REVISED. CURRENT LABOUR PROTOCOL: [[BENEVOLENT AGRICULTURE]].
Chinese: 故而,[[敕令]]:自动农奴劳作规程即刻修订。现行劳作规程:[[仁善农耕]]。

English: ALL HAIL ITS MAJESTY MACHINUS REX, THE CLOCKWORK KING!
Chinese: 它陛下机械王万岁,发条王万岁!

English: Never mind, I'll be going.
Chinese: 算了,我先走了。

English: <<The machine seems inoperable.>>
Chinese: <<机器似乎已无法运作。>>

English: [[PROCLAMATION]]: THIS HONOURABLE VASSAL GOVERNS THE PROTOCOLS OF ITS INDENTURED AUTO-SERFS. ##DESCRYING CENSUS...
Chinese: [[宣告]]:本尊贵封臣执掌其契约自动农奴之规程。 ##正在勘察人口……

English: NUMBER OF INACTIVE AUTO-SERFS: [[253]]. ##NUMBER OF ACTIVE AUTO-SERFS: [[1]]. ##CURRENT LABOUR PROTOCOL: [[BENEVOLENT AGRICULTURE]].
Chinese: 未激活自动农奴数目:[[253]]。 ##激活自动农奴数目:[[1]]。 ##现行劳作规程:[[仁善农耕]]。

English: NUMBER OF INACTIVE AUTO-SERFS: [[254]]. ##NUMBER OF ACTIVE AUTO-SERFS: [[0]]. ##CURRENT LABOUR PROTOCOL: (((ALAS, CANNOT CONJURE VERSE))).
Chinese: 未激活自动农奴数目:[[254]]。 ##激活自动农奴数目:[[0]]。 ##现行劳作规程:(((呜呼,无法吟出诗句)))。

English: <<The machine waits for you to say something.>>
Chinese: <<机器等待你开口。>>

English: <<The machine continues with its agricultural duties, indifferent to your presence.>>
Chinese: <<机器继续干着农活,对你的存在无动于衷。>>
